review:
Начну, пожалуй, со слабых мест. Основным из них, традиционно для серии, является сюжет. Он тут чисто для галочки, чтобы объяснить нам причину, по которой нам нужно бить разных чудищ и залезать во всё более укромные уголки этого мира.

Звуковое сопровождение. Тут мне не к чему придраться, у значимых чудовищ есть собственные саундтреки, так что можно по музыке узнать кто на тебя выпрыгнул со спины.
Звуки мира и чудищ отлично сгущают атмосферу недружелюбного к человеку мира, а пафосные аккорды придают сил в нелёгких сражениях.

Графика и техническое состояние отличное. Даже на стимдеке стабильно держит свои 45 кадров. Не назову это каким-то некстгеном, игре уже всё-таки восемь лет, но она не ощущается устаревшей. Мир отлично читается, глаза тут же цепляются за значимые вещи, чтобы быстро оценить ситуацию на поле. В то же время порой можно выйти на прекрасные виды заходящего солнца с какого-нибудь обрыва.

Ну, а теперь к тому, ради чего люди вообще эту серию берут: геймплей и прокачка.
Почти со старта нам выдают оружия всех 14 видов и ведут в тренировочную комнату - пробуй!

Это, наверное, самое важное решение в игре. Все оружия кардинально отличаются по геймплею. С глефой или двумя клинками ты будешь играть в слэшер.
С луком или легким лукорудием - в тактический шутер.
С тяжёлыми типами вооружения получишь солслайк, где каждое движение нужно продумывать, иначе есть шанс оказаться в невыгодном положении прямо во время удара противника.
С длинным мечом - самурайский боевик с резкими выхватами из ножен и точными выпадами! 
С охотничьим рогом ты играешь за саппорта, в том числе для себя.
А заряженный клинок превращает тебя в боевого бухгалтера, которому точно нужно бдить балансы зарядов и расчитывать когда и на какой вид оружия нужно переключиться, когда его зарядить, а когда превратить в трёхметровое убер-молотило.

Но тут есть важный нюанс: оружие ты выбираешь не по тому, какой геймплей тебя вдохновляет, а по тому, с какими его минусами ты готов мириться:
Тяжелые оружия - проблемы с мобильностью.
Легкие - постоянно нужно за чем-то следить: выносливостью, остротой, патронами, чем-то его заряжать и пр.
А рог - это вообще отдельная миниигра при каждом баффе, ни на что не похожий опыт прохождения.
Безусловно, у каждого из них есть плюсы перед другими, но это дело второстепенное. Важнее, чтобы оружие не бесило тебя долгие 100+ часов.

И тут самый удивительный момент: оружие настолько разнообразно, что для каждого находится что-то своё. И то что тебе кажется неиграбельным, другой игрок оценит "а норм, с этим вполне можно жить". А когда освоишь своё оружие, то уже точно не захочешь поменять его на что-то другое до конца игры.

Почему так важно правильно определиться с оружием в начале? Потому что оружие прокачивается тут по дереву прокачки. И если ты, дорогой читатель, вдруг решишь сменить его посередине игры, то тебе не только придётся его с нуля освоить, но и прокачать нужное тебе по уровню ковыряло с самого начала. Но это обычно не очень сложно, т.к. скорее всего у тебя будут излишки лута с прошлых походов, а боссов начальных уровней по мере прокачки бить становится совсем просто.

В общем, боевая система тут сложна и непривычна, но она однозначно стоит того, чтобы в неё углубиться. Те же солсы во многом были вдохновлены (если не сказать "списаны") с Monster Hunter.

И вторая вещь, которая вызывает недоумение в начале игры, а по окончанию ты осознаёшь насколько она продумана до мелочей, это интерфейс. В игре уйма кнопочек в разных менюшках и порой нужно спрашивать у интернета как сделать ту или иную вещь. Обязательно читайте легенду для кнопок под каждым меню, а то можете пропустить очень удобные штуки. 
И вот когда ты ознакомишься со всеми механиками, то начинаешь понимать, что СТОЛЬКО возможностей невозможно распихать на простом интерфейсе. Тут одновременно нужно и уметь крафтить лечилки, и выбирать снаряды для самострела, и руководить палико, и смайликами общаться, и ловушки ставить, и многое другое, зачастую, прямо во время боя! И авторы справились с этим просто потрясно: есть четыре круговых меню  (выбираешь нужное действие стиком) и меню быстрого доступа (чтобы просто нажав на X выбранное действие выполнилось). И когда это всё под себя настроишь - то ощущаешь себя асом истребителя, настолько всё четко и слажено получается.

Но есть и промашки, поэтому если вы что-то увидели и не знаете что это, зачем оно нужно или откуда взять - спросите у интернета или ИИ, некоторые вещи авторы оставили для самых пытливых исследователей.
Например, я только через 120+ часов игры понял, что палико (про них чуть позже) можно менять инструменты и он может не только лечить! Это было такое прозрение, которое поменяло игру на до и после. А почему я не сделал этого раньше? Про это в следующем разделе.

Система заданий: в игре есть сюжетные, дополнительные, событийные и особые задания, и расследования. Так вот, за годы их наделали столько разных, что глаза разбегаются. И вот тут кроется главная ошибка: дополнительные задания стоит выполнять практически все. Даже если там нет очевидных призов в описании, то прохождение может дать проход к нужному заданию или просто выпадет что-то крайне полезное. Так я и профукал за одним невыполненным заданием без приза в описании длинную цепочку прокачки своего главного помощника - палико.

О палико: это прямоходящий кот, который помогает тебе если игрешь один или вдвоём. Т.к. в пати не может быть больше 4 членов, то при игре вчетвером палико остаются в стороне. Он прокачивается вместе с тобой и обрастает арсеналом весьма полезных инструментов. Так что не пропускайте его квесты, т.к. инструменты отнюдь не единственная причина, по которой стоит пройти все дополнительные квесты компаньона.
Особенно, если играете в одиночку.

С сюжетными, думаю, всё понятно. Событийные - скорее проверка умений. Они часто требуются в еженедельных квестах и за них дают неплохую награду. А особые квесты - это DLC и походы на самых элитных боссов. Тут по желанию, я пропустил всякие кроссоверы, а остальные все прошёл. В одном из таких квестов получил самую полезную накидку в игре.

Про онлайн: несмотря на почётные 8 лет с выхода, онлайн в игре стабилен. Почти всегда на трудных боссов можно призвать помощь. Однако, в сюжетных миссиях сначала нужно посмотреть сюжетные же вставки, а только после них откроется возможность призыва.

Про трудных боссов: думаю всех их вполне можно пройти в одиночку, но я не советую. В одиночку можно и задушниться, мне кажется, даже если играешь с нонеймами из сети. В первую очередь - это кооперативная игра. И двух человек тут вполне достаточно, чтобы сделать её незабываемой и обрести кучу совместных воспоминаний.

Однако, не стоит забывать, что каждая охота требует подготовки: нужная броня и камни в ней, подходящее оружие, лечилки и антидоты, ловушки, и, главное, хорошо покушать перед заходом - всё это крайне важно для успеха. 
Если выполнить все пункты, то даже самый трудный босс не устоит перед вашим напором.

Ну и в конце: почему именно World, а не более новые Rise или Wilds? По тому, что я прочёл в интернетах, именно World до сих пор остаётся вершиной серии: по количеству контента, по оптимизации, по разнообразию механик и пр. Поэтому если вы хотели попробовать эту серию и разобраться что так много людей в ней нашло, то это лучшая точка входа по моему мнению.

TLDR: если хотите коопертивное приключение про выслеживание и охоту на огромных драконов со вдумчивыми боями часов на 150-200, то вам однозначно сюда. Если вам совсем не с кем играть, но хочется попробовать непривычную, но очень интересную систему боя, то тоже стоит попробовать. Благо игра сейчас со всеми дополнениями стоит совсем немного. Если это всё не про вас, то можете просто кинуть в желаемое, т.к. товар штучный и желание поиграть в него когда-нибудь может прийти. Игра возрождает внутри то детское ощущение исследования неизведанного мира, различных механик и систем, которое многие из нас по мере взросления могли потерять.

Ну, а теперь к тому, ради чего люди вообще эту серию берут: геймплей и прокачка. Почти со старта нам выдают оружия всех 14 видов и ведут в тренировочную комнату - пробуй! С тяжёлыми типами вооружения получишь солслайк, где каждое движение нужно продумывать, иначе есть шанс оказаться в невыгодном положении прямо во время удара противника. С длинным мечом - самурайский боевик с резкими выхватами из ножен и точными выпадами! С охотничьим рогом ты играешь за саппорта, в том числе для себя. А заряженный клинок превращает тебя в боевого бухгалтера, которому точно нужно бдить балансы зарядов и расчитывать когда и на какой вид оружия нужно переключиться, когда его зарядить, а когда превратить в трёхметровое убер-молотило. Но тут есть важный нюанс: оружие ты выбираешь не по тому, какой геймплей тебя вдохновляет, а по тому, с какими его минусами ты готов мириться: Тяжелые оружия - проблемы с мобильностью. Легкие - постоянно нужно за чем-то следить: выносливостью, остротой, патронами, чем-то его заряжать и пр. А рог - это вообще отдельная миниигра при каждом баффе, ни на что не похожий опыт прохождения. Безусловно, у каждого из них есть плюсы перед другими, но это дело второстепенное. Важнее, чтобы оружие не бесило тебя долгие 100+ часов. И тут самый удивительный момент: оружие настолько разнообразно, что для каждого находится что-то своё. Почему так важно правильно определиться с оружием в начале? Потому что оружие прокачивается тут по дереву прокачки. Но это обычно не очень сложно, т.к. скорее всего у тебя будут излишки лута с прошлых походов, а боссов начальных уровней по мере прокачки бить становится совсем просто. В общем, боевая система тут сложна и непривычна, но она однозначно стоит того, чтобы в неё углубиться. Те же солсы во многом были вдохновлены (если не сказать "списаны") с Monster Hunter. И вторая вещь, которая вызывает недоумение в начале игры, а по окончанию ты осознаёшь насколько она продумана до мелочей, это интерфейс. В игре уйма кнопочек в разных менюшках и порой нужно спрашивать у интернета как сделать ту или иную вещь. Обязательно читайте легенду для кнопок под каждым меню, а то можете пропустить очень удобные штуки. И вот когда ты ознакомишься со всеми механиками, то начинаешь понимать, что СТОЛЬКО возможностей невозможно распихать на простом интерфейсе. Тут одновременно нужно и уметь крафтить лечилки, и выбирать снаряды для самострела, и руководить палико, и смайликами общаться, и ловушки ставить, и многое другое, зачастую, прямо во время боя! Даже если там нет очевидных призов в описании, то прохождение может дать проход к нужному заданию или просто выпадет что-то крайне полезное. Так я и профукал за одним невыполненным заданием без приза в описании длинную цепочку прокачки своего главного помощника - палико. Он прокачивается вместе с тобой и обрастает арсеналом весьма полезных инструментов. А особые квесты - это DLC и походы на самых элитных боссов. Тут по желанию, я пропустил всякие кроссоверы, а остальные все прошёл. В одном из таких квестов получил самую полезную накидку в игре. Про онлайн: несмотря на почётные 8 лет с выхода, онлайн в игре стабилен. Почти всегда на трудных боссов можно призвать помощь. Однако, в сюжетных миссиях сначала нужно посмотреть сюжетные же вставки, а только после них откроется возможность призыва. Если выполнить все пункты, то даже самый трудный босс не устоит перед вашим напором. Ну и в конце: почему именно World, а не более новые Rise или Wilds? По тому, что я прочёл в интернетах, именно World до сих пор остаётся вершиной серии: по количеству контента, по оптимизации, по разнообразию механик и пр. Поэтому если вы хотели попробовать эту серию и разобраться что так много людей в ней нашло, то это лучшая точка входа по моему мнению. TLDR: если хотите коопертивное приключение про выслеживание и охоту на огромных драконов со вдумчивыми боями часов на 150-200, то вам однозначно сюда. Если вам совсем не с кем играть, но хочется попробовать непривычную, но очень интересную систему боя, то тоже стоит попробовать. Благо игра сейчас со всеми дополнениями стоит совсем немного. Если это всё не про вас, то можете просто кинуть в желаемое, т.к. товар штучный и желание поиграть в него когда-нибудь может прийти. Игра возрождает внутри то детское ощущение исследования неизведанного мира, различных механик и систем, которое многие из нас по мере взросления могли потерять.

review:
One of the most fun games I've ever played, It isn't perfect as it can get very grindy in many place of the game, but the loop of hunting monsters, getting better gear to hunt stronger monsters, to get even better gear rarely feels all that tedious because every hunt feel just that little different to spice things.  This game has beautiful sights, models and maps, a complicated but mostly intuitive menu system and genuinely good balancing and hit boxes. 

The story isn't anything to write home about but its interesting enough for a game that is essentially a boss rush with semi-open environments to explore and gather resources.  

with friends (as with many games) its even more fun, as the game is built with cooperation and coordination with a group just as much if perhaps a bit more then with solo players.  Not to mention it have an extremely open and friendly community who are always ready to help new players. 

In addition to this the dlc expansion Iceborne is actually bigger then the base game and offers more of the same while adding more then enough to justify a new expansion and reward the skills you refined in the base game.

if you want a well paced combat focused game that lets you turn your brain off or lock in depending on your mood, or just need something to mess around with your group for hours on end without much muss or fuss. Monster Hunter World is already the game for you.  Buy Monster Hunter World:Iceborne, you won't regret.  

P.S: Stay away from the guardian armor set and defender weapons they completely ruin the base game's progression and you will be very frustrated when you get to Iceborne and suddenly you aren't tanking damage like you used to. They are basically for speed running to the DLC.  I made this mistake and nearly rage quit on one of the early bosses in the DLC cuz I just wasn't as good as the game expected me to be due to being carried by Guardian Armor, or Defender gear.

Te odio Kulu-ya-ku en este y en cada juego que aparezcas, los cazare hasta que desaparezcan, dicho esto gran juego.
Pros:
 Para mi una obra maestra, del genero, la variedad de armas que ofrece el juego permite que explores varios tipos de arma para descubrir cual te gusta mas, El sistema de ecosistemas vivos le dan a este monster hunter algo que no tenian entregas anteriores, ver monstruos comiendose otros le da un toque especial a este, en cuanto al sistema de seguimiento de los monstruos sigue guardando un poco la escensia de los anteriores de tener que descubir un monstruo que no conocia, pero con un extra que serian los lafarillos te ayudan a seguir monstruos o materiales que en entregas anteriores era realmente engorroso de realizar, 

Cons:
El hecho de que el mundo sea tan grande en cada uno de los ecosistemas, se siente a veces abrumador cuando estas empezando, la historia es un poco vacia y parece como solo darle una vago sentido al porque cazas monstruos, Los menus y la interfaz si bien mejoraron en cuanto a entregas anteriores siguen siendo bastante complicadas de entender, mas que todo para nuevos jugadores, El sistema de emparejamiento al jugar multijugador es un asco, si estoy jugando con mis amigos me gustaria poder verlos por ahi justo como en MH RIse no solo en una sala random que nadie visita. el hecho de que no te deje unirte a las misiones hasta que el host no vea una cinematica con el monstruo en cuestion es bastante aburridor 

Conclusion,
El juego es muy bueno, se disfruta solo y aun mas con amigos, siempre vas a poder encontrar cazadores que esten dispuestos a ayudarte. Es una entrega que se disfruta tanto por cazadores veteranos como para nuevos cazadores entusiastas.

review: 这个游戏承载了我太多的回忆，记得刚开始玩时因为找不到风漂龙退游了很多次，之后在一个朋友的怂恿下又下了回来，并选择了太刀这把武器，从此便一发不可收拾（唉，太刀）......刚开始连成功见切这种操作都难以打出，很多怪都是朋友带着打过的，居合这种高风险高收益的操作更不用说，刚进入冰原时甚至差点一度被虐到退游，不过还是坚持了下来，直到我遇到一个叫“再会了，雷狼龙”的任务......雷狼龙真是太适合太刀练习了，在不断狩猎雷狼龙的过程中我终于可以熟练见切和居合怪物的招式，也逐渐体会到了太刀这把武器真正的魅力。再根据攻略做完了炎王龙校服后终于开始挑战黑龙了，刚开始失败了很多次、使用了各种手段后才艰难战胜P1，最后还是呼叫了天尊，过了第一只黑龙。在攒出黑龙套后决定独自挑战，那时每天刷手机都会看各种太黑攻略，终于在一个星期的不断尝试后用时28分钟独自击败了传说中的黑龙，心中的喜悦难以言喻！之后又去尝试了各种帅气的处理和登龙点，太刀也是玩得越来越熟练了，我也开始冒充天尊帮新入坑的朋友们开荒打怪，那段时间很快乐，电脑完全就是怪猎启动器，集会里非常热闹，出任务时有人被打出大毅力就会有圣人撒粉，有人猫车大家就会狠狠嘲笑......虽然后面因为各种原因大家都淡游了，很久都没有打开过怪猎了，但想起那段难忘的时光还是会很开心！第一次听到月辰据点的背景配乐时，我感到其乐融融，很和谐，现在再听却徒增了一缕淡淡的忧伤，真是怀念那段无忧无虑的日子啊！

Except for one thing.

Primal Aspids.

Whoever coded these tiny yellow demons in Kingdom’s Edge needs to be studied by scientists. They don't just shoot three-way acid; they calculate your exact soul, destiny, and dash trajectory with military-grade precision. Trying to do the Trial of the Fool while these flying war crimes exist will test your sanity like nothing else. its a  10/10 game and primal aspid is a 0/10 bug. Buy it, but prepare to lose your mind to a fly.

review:
I started playing Hollow Knight just over a year ago, and yet I still remember that first playthrough like it was yesterday. Before Hollow Knight I was like a sheltered toddler in terms of what kind of games I played. A lot of Nintendo. Some Minecraft. A few indie games. So when I booted up Hollow Knight for the first time, I had absolutely no idea what to expect.

The first couple hours were rough. Really, really rough. I was convinced I had finally bought a game that I simply wasn't going to enjoy. The enemies were ridiculously punishing, I had absolutely no sense of direction, and there wasn't even a clear objective of where to go next.

Then, slowly, but surely, I start to get my bearings. 3 hours later, time seems to disappear and I become fully immersed in the beauty of Hallownest. Every inch of the map was something new; the game never punished you for exploring every nook and cranny. It was so rewarding, and the more I played the more I understood just how expansive the world was.

Fast forward 217 hours, and I had every achievement and had 112% completed the game four separate times, including on Steel Soul. And I loved every second of it. This game is not one to sleep on.

The soundtrack is [i]immaculate[/i]. Often times you don't even notice it and it blends in perfectly with the environment. Other times it perfectly captures the scale of a cutscene, like Sealed Vessel.

The art direction is also phenomenal. Every little detail is accounted for, and every area has something unique about it. There are few things more rewarding than sitting down at the hidden bench in Greenpath, with a beautiful waterfall in the background to accompany you. Or walking into City of Tears for the first time. Or brutally navigating your way through Deepnest on one singular mask and finding relief at an unexpected hot spring.

The progression is done incredibly well. I would by no means describe Hollow Knight as linear, yet you can still always tell when you've made progress. The game also handles difficulty really well. Most players agree that the early game of Hollow Knight [i]feels[/i] the hardest, even though the late and end game are objectively harder. This is because by the time you make it to those sections, they don't feel unfair, as the game has already taught you how to overcome them.

I'm writing this review for my 1 year anniversary since I started playing to reminisce on what a masterpiece this game is. If you're somehow lucky enough to have never played it, PLEASE do. You will not regret it and will enjoy this game for a very long time.

10/10

review:
Hollow Knight is a good game that every other Indievania took the wrong lessons from. The correct lesson they should've taken is that sequence breaking and nonlinear exploration is a fundamental core of the genre, yet most Indievanias complete forget this feature ie they've never actually played a METROID game before. 

Hollow Knight itself is more like a 6.5 out of 10 than anything else. If you do just the core content its an enjoyable experience, however the side content as zero appeal to me and I find it actively a reason I don't return to it often.
Almost all the side content is higher end combat driven or platforming, two things I think that aren't very good in this game.

Ghost's jump is tight enough but the dash feels awkward and his nail is such a stubby piece of trash that while the game really isn't hard it just ends up making the combat feel limp. Thats the other thing is that the game really isn't very hard, the optional stuff is sure, but the main content isn't which might be a blessing cause of my prior statement honestly. 

On top of this while I like the exploration as a whole package I would argue the game kind of has a bad map, areas  simply have too many rooms that makes exploration a little tedious at times, on top of the fact that I think the entire right side of the map is completely trash in layout but is made up for by the entire LEFT side of the map being great.

 优点：
剧情有深意，悲剧感和故事感浓厚，回味感强。护符搭配自由，玩法多样。探索自由，圣巢各个区域风格差别鲜明，沉浸感拉满。3战斗手感扎实，通关成就感很强。

 缺点：
 几乎无引导，对新手不友好。部分Boss挑战门槛很高(列如：梦魇之王)。死亡会掉落金币，存档点离Boss房较远，反复跑图很磨耐心。游戏依旧存在bug(收集齐容器碎片合成容器时不要大退，会导致不能进入护符页面，且再次收集容器碎片时卡死)

 总结：适合愿意耐心探索、接受高难度的玩家。

可能因为hk是我pc端第一部游戏，所以不可避免地有一些滤镜，但空洞骑士系列确实是我玩过最优秀的游戏之一。
最后，悲恸之海什么时候出。

review:
极少见到跑图比黑暗之魂还恶心的游戏
26/10/26 时长：9小时
可以在任何地方找到恶心点的游戏。垃圾到极致的跳跳乐关卡，每个平台跳跃小关里都有的精准锁定飞行怪，可以和你跳起时同步一击即中，配合越死越难的死亡黑色怪物，可以在满是尖刺的狭小缝隙里，堵住你的路，让你被迫白白损失生命跳上去；无聊的跑图，跑图，还是跑图，又长又无聊，boss门前绝对不会有椅子，我一大半的时间都在跑图，和杀死那些一样的蚊子，和大号的蚊子；每到一个新区域前必定经历的晕头转向，走了一大段区域找不到地图师，我根本无法确定自己在什么地方，我甚至不能打开地图看我基于其他地图的相对位置，我不明白谁会喜欢这种设计，有的小畜生就会说“你去看攻略不就好了”，如果一个游戏极其依赖外部攻略，那我希望游戏作者直接内置一个攻略就好了，或者直接内置通关系统，按下按钮就可以自动游玩；还有长按回血的机制，这绝对是我见过的最垃圾的机制之一，任何体验过这个机制的人都不会喜欢这个机制。
没有亮点，我没有记住游戏任一区域的样子，我讨厌只有平A和跳跃的战斗，还有游戏设计者无能为了拉长游戏时长而设计的极少的椅子和传送点和低劣的跳跳乐。

剧情：碎片魂式，实际上受限于体量，并没有特别深的可挖掘的内容。
音乐：初听很好听，但是整体偏阴郁，搭上晦涩灰暗的剧情，以及阴暗的画面，游戏给人感觉过于沉重。
可玩性：喜欢跳跳乐的玩家值得入，喜欢动作游戏的慎入，喜欢剧情的免入。大量跑图过程非常无聊，可探索的内容最后都要通过攻略才能接触到。
通关即删，神居boss一个没打，因为这作打boss基本也是跳跳乐。
=============================================
很久以前买的，用键盘玩到真菌荒地，被下劈弹跳搞崩了，就一直扔在库中。
今年尝试了下手柄，完美解决下劈问题，于是一路玩了起来。这次重玩游戏评论分别在10小时，40小时，和现在60小时通关写了第三次。

40多小时的时候，因为在白宫和无尽的跑地图中感到很枯燥，加上游戏中各种小恶意的设计积累到一起，把推荐改成了不推荐，并写了一堆差评。

review:
Game is a great introduction into jumping territory. Instead of dumping all the mechanics on the player at once, the game introduces them gradually, one by one. Main story route introduces collectibles which do not matter and only purpose (outside of achievements little bit) is to make the player dip into higher difficulty jumps. 

Once you finish the game (main storyline eta 6 hours), you are either satisfied or you want more jumping levels and this game provides that. 

Pros:
+ For the main storyline, levels are made short to be less frustrating, which worked
+ Great music/sfx
+ Pixel art for level design is a great choice, considering you have less distraction in the level while enough orientation where everything is
+ Cute story, good enough to enjoy it while also not really necessary to focus on
+ Game has great level of key imputs, feeling like most of the mistakes player makes are on him
+ Developers gave some generous hitboxes

Cons:
- Like i get it, but i really hated cycles, where you have to estimate them from start and hopefully hit them in the middle of room.
- In later levels i got somewhat confused of the path i need to take. In some cases i had to search up the solution. Can be called skill issue and someone finds them as a puzzle to solve, but i would love some indicators instead.


Final result for completing all achievements:
57 hours and ~16 000 deaths. Am i Proud of it? Yes, for my first jumping genre game outside of Hollow Knigh/Silksong i think i did well and i enjoyed every moment.

review:
Beautiful story-telling wrapped in a challenging game.

I very much appreciated the themes of self-acceptance, depression, perseverance, and identity in this game. The game doesn't present these topics too on the nose, nor too vaguely. I liked the challenging and precise platforming, although I don't think I will go back to get all collectibles as I know the game will only get harder in the post-game and I think I've reached my skill ceiling.

I liked the pixel art that makes for beautiful environments and very distinct levels, each with their unique gimmicks and puzzles to complete. The characters are likeable and mostly shine in their full artwork. I especially love the details in Celeste's design, when you obtain the second dash, turning you from pink to blue. The ending of the game feels very gratifying and does not punish the player with the most atrocious platforming made to torture you. The controls are smooth and snappy, best experienced with a controller.

Overall a very enjoyable experience with themes I much appreciated.

review:
When I played this game for the first time, I wasn't expecting much. I knew it wasn't an easy platformer, but it was way harder than I expected. Because of that, I dropped the game at chapter 4 in 2023 and haven't thought about it since.

Three years later, I decided to look through my Steam library and found this game abandoned in the dust. I decided to try it again from the very beginning, and oh man... it's freaking amazing.

I can't praise enough how fluid the movement feels, with the camera naturally tracking your character. It's also not as punishing as games like Getting Over It or Jump King, as it features checkpoints and lets you practice any room you want at your own pace. You can also save your progress anytime you want and come back to it whenever you feel like it.

The story is also amazing and very relatable. Our main protagonist, Mabeline, struggles with laziness and wants to prove to herself that she can accomplish anything she desires, even something as crazy as climbing to the top of a mountain. She goes through natural character development and proves to us players that if we truly desire something, we can achieve it. 

If you love challenging games that make you feel devastated after countless failures, but absolutely amazing after you accomplish your goal, this is the perfect game. I will keep playing to get 100% achievement completion, as it's truly worth it.

Got this game for free on Epic, decided to buy it here cuz fuck epic but also this game deserves the money.

Insanely mechanically tight, it will put your keyboard / controller's buttons (especially the fucking Dpad) under severe scrutiny, especially in the last few challenges. I'd rather not spoil anything tough, you wanna experience every level and feature blind.

The story is neat. I remember really liking it when I first played it, now I'm kinda meh on it, but that's probably just cuz of the state of mind I'm in. It's an analogy for overcoming hardships (not some tranny shit as "the tolerant and inclusive" communities on the internet would have you believe)

However, I think it's beyond retarded to give a game with this theme a fucking practice mode. Wtf was the dev thinking with that one I have no idea. Do not touch it, the intended experience is to figure every room out or die trying, not getting a fucking cheatmode to stroll through and find every secret without a hitch.

There are very very few instances of the game cheating, I don't recall them all anymore, but the most recent one is, for instance, a certain block falling faster than others when it fucking shouldn't in the hardest level (excluding the DLC). These are very rare, but they will piss you the fuck off since they have a major impact.

I guess I should say that I have not finished Farewell yet, I just finished [i] everything else [/i] though and now I'm taking a fucking break. 

Overall this game is a 9/10, and very close to a 9.5 at that. Mechanically tighter than any mario game, almost as consistent as fucking chess, despite being quite simple in the amount of mechanics the game provides. It milks them to the maximum and expects you to master them all.

Also the soundtrack is great, a shame [spoiler] the C sides [/spoiler] do not have a unique variation of the track, and also Golden Ridge Remix sucks ass.

[h1] 神作！但是请谨慎购入游玩 [/h1]
蔚蓝这款游戏是一款极高难度的“横版平台跳跃游戏”（[spoiler] 平台跳跃游戏，但是并没有平台 [/spoiler]），可以说是最难的横版平台跳跃游戏之一。所以，//[b] 对于没玩过或只玩过一些简单的平台跳跃游戏，以及没有耐心的玩家，我极为不推荐你们游玩这款游戏！ [/b]//如果不听劝游玩，你将会被游戏的各种花样死法，以及各种365里路给劝退。随后怒打差评，并将游戏美美扔进库里吃灰并在之后后悔为什么要玩这款游戏。
[h3] 但是！[/h3]如果你是平台跳跃重度爱好者，并有着极高的耐心，那请你一定一定不要错过这款游戏。
以下是个人认为[u] 蔚蓝的优缺点 [/u]（不喜勿喷）

------分界线------

[b] 美术音乐 [/b]:无敌！画风虽然是像素，但十分的唯美精致，很好看。音乐那更是神中神，可以说是这款游戏的灵魂。其与关卡的配合更是游戏的最大魅力所在。例如:二三章被追逐时的刺激、第四张逆风而行时的紧张、第五章的神秘，恐怖、第六章在追坏madeline的紧张刺激等。当然对于我来说最为震撼的当然是第七章的登山；从最底端，到一步步上升，再到最终的登山。其音乐也是从一开始的比较单纯，到后来越来越丰富，再到临近登山时的那种震撼感，可以说完全无法用言语来表达。正因为这美术，音乐才给了我能坚持玩一下这款游戏的动力。总之，美术神！音乐神！
[b] 玩法 [/b]:表面看上去，主角前期就只有冲刺这一个技能，甚至就连二段跳也是大后期才有。看上去未来是一款简单游戏，但并非如此，他表面上看上去基础技能简单，但所衍生出来的高级技巧十分多，更别提每一章都会新出1~3个新机制以及其衍生出来的高级技巧（[spoiler] 以及更多花样的死法 [/spoiler]）。所以说，蔚蓝上限极为高，甚至有些高级技巧连作者都没想到，都是依靠玩家一点点发掘出来的。而在使用并成功利用各种技巧通关后的那一刻，成就感简直拉满。因此强烈去推进游玩，感受一下。总之，玩法强！
剧情:我是skip党，没看过。
[b] 总结[/b]:蔚蓝这一款游戏素以极高难度与强大的美术，音乐和剧情而闻名。许多人都被其难度而劝退，选择了云通关。但游戏的玩法和乐趣与其本身表达的内涵，终究还是需要亲身游玩才能去感受到（更别提官方还提供了帮助模式这一官方作弊器）但正如我前文所提到的，这游戏终究不适合大多数人坚持游玩下去，但我还是会希望读到这里的您去亲身体验一下这款游戏，谢谢。
当然，你问我是如何坚持游玩下去的？之前我可能会说被其美术，音乐与玩法。但现在的我会说:[b] 因为山就在那里 [/b]。

review: ns2《celeste蔚蓝》，平台跳跃游戏没有“平台”的 2015年最佳年度独立游戏，从最初的pc到ps4再到ns1直到今天的ns2，我才想起来有曾经这么一款神作没有通关，于是乎一口气给通关了，当然没有所谓追求什么abc面全草莓全蓝心，就连第九关我都没有打，因为我觉得前七关主线的难度已经很完美契合我的跳跃水平了，前几周有通关《茶杯头》玩到后面越来越简单找到了规律，这几年大众的什么空洞两部也都第一时间通关了，其实说实话“跳跳乐”我还挺拿手，最终也是比较符合预期5小时21分1469次死亡还是用手柄玩通关了，游戏操作就仅有跳跃冲刺抓取快到结局和自己内心负面形象和解后得到的二段跳，其实二段跳之后虽然难度急增但已经很享受跳跃的过程了，因为机动性变强了，每一次死亡都是让你对路线重构的机会，几乎没有什么挫败感不像《丝之歌》那种类银里面塞满恶意条条乐的。顺带一嘴，ns2就是适合这种ign10分经久不衰无论多长时间都会被玩家捧为神作的独立小游，夯爆了。经典永远经典。

可是最后看到奶奶，还是释怀了。不知道为什么的。
蔚蓝是独一份的，你无法找到能和他相媲美的同类型作品，音乐，手感，进阶技巧，特殊机制，地图设计全可称之为艺术。而剧情我也认为是恰到好处的。
但是，恶意也充斥期间，后面b,c面大段大段的马拉松，有的望远镜看不到所有地图，恶意的屏幕滚动防自救。不给存档点真的是非常恶毒的做法，他不仅让你跑365里路而且每一段路都必须保持绝对注意力，游戏里不是八向判定就是大小跳区分，还有凌波和蹭墙这种数帧数的操作，每一步都这么搞非常消耗精力和手指耐久，跑365里路就是为了在某一段再死一次。
可是...可是我最后还是原谅了蔚蓝，就好像我原谅了所有让我痛苦的东西一样。
“All tragedy erased.I see only wonders...”

review: 很久以前拿手柄玩了蔚蓝打到了第九章,可惜最后没打完匆匆忙忙看了一下结局.前阵子打算重新用键盘玩,个人感觉手柄不如键盘好操作,手柄太不准确了而且手柄玩这游戏容易按坏,键盘斜向冲刺准确点,我觉得手柄打到高难度肯定不好打的,但是从普遍大多数玩家的角度来说,手柄打到登顶的体验还是很不错的.蔚蓝这款游戏我觉得挺适合休闲和硬核玩家去玩.就登山而言普通玩家也能得到很多乐趣.如果你问我这游戏难吗,其实我觉得从难易来评价游戏是不合理的,应该从难度曲线来评价才行.蔚蓝这游戏的难度曲线很合理,并不会说突然给你一个莫名其妙的机制让你立马就要求会用,蔚蓝的关卡设计难度曲线我觉得是很多游戏开发者可以去学的,而且游戏节奏设计很恰当,过了一个难的后面往往给你简单的来放松,就休闲和硬核来说蔚蓝做的都很不错,游戏操作手感很棒,为此开发者还专门做了一大堆优化手感的方式.玩家社区也一直活跃着,有各种各样玩家自做的图,硬核玩家能找到乐趣,休闲玩家也可以去玩玩那些观赏图.蔚蓝是一款适合绝大多数人的游戏,挺值的推荐的.

如果你是天才 绝对推荐，操作有挑战性也有较难理解、但还算好的剧情
如果不是天才 酌情选择，要用努力堆成果以及不一定能理解的剧情

为了难而难的游戏，容错率极低或者说没有，过关了也没有获得爽感，尤其是第三章真的是垃圾中的垃圾，玩一款游戏不仅仅是为了通关，中间的体验过程也非常的重要，历经千辛万苦攀登到了山顶，我们当然会感慨过程如此不容易，但是这种感受大可不必。吃苦或许是好的品质，但是绝对不应该去歌颂吃苦。魂游有很多恶意，但是你可以有很多解法，探索的过程很有意思，但是这个游戏不是，苦难和过关方法就摆在你面前，你需要做的是无数次没有容错的尝试，赌那一次成功。
看了别人的评论发现漏掉了一些东西，手柄方向判定真的很垃圾，经常没法朝我想要的方向冲刺，还有弹墙跳真的非常反直觉，狭窄的墙壁一共才多少，我需要你给我省这点操作吗，每次扒着墙超前跳然后被这个弹墙跳害死，我都要跳跃了，这个RT还得继续按死吗，玩了几个小时才发现。游戏我会通关的，但是差评不可能改，玩奥日死几百次但是玩得很爽，没有死亡惩罚死再多次也无所谓，这游戏我明明知道怎么操作，但是还是得反复尝试，在很多次连续极限跳跃的过程中赌自己完全不失误。
老贼的魂游我都通关了，魂2这坨我都吃了，耐心是绝对有的，我发现很多人真的是很爱看别人吃苦，我这种没有粉丝的主播直播这种吃苦游戏总是有不少人来观看，还会全程教你怎么玩。

review:
Never thought I'd really enjoy a roguelike as much as I dig Darkest Dungeon at this point.

The story is simple and blunt, your goal given right on without too much context about everything. And given the focus of the game is the gameplay and about dungeon exploring, this is perfectly fine.

The graphics and music has a dark atmosphere in general, enhancing the setting and giving it the right vibes for the gloomy and dark situations you're getting thrown in. The art style has its nice and recognizable way to make the trips into the dungeons and explore those a good experience overall.

Given the genre, it's a repetitive cycle of you preparing your characters for the next exploration trip, expand your options in town to make them stronger, make services cheaper, and giving you better odds at not running into misery. Many classes to pick and build your teams around, themed teams for specific dungeon types making things a bit easier within those. Given the amount of skills every class has, you can go with different approaches and builds for them, not being a one-way ticket to only get used as a tank but a tank also able to go into an offensive build if you like this approach more.

Dungeon exploration is a matter how many items you took with you and into what obstacles you'll run eventually. Dungeon designs randomized, some dungeons ending up with a more tedious room layout, some on the straight and simple progression. Resource management will decide how decent or not a trip will be, gathering items to sell or collect for town upgrades, making decisions what to keep and what to drop as the inventory isn't the biggest. Quest tasks vary from exploring the whole dungeon to find specific objects to interact or to collect, different sizes and difficulties for the dungeons existing.

Battles are in general RPG style, choosing the skills you want to use, having specific ranges or positions you have to be in to use those. Hit and dodge chances giving everything an RNG touch while turn order also not solely relying on one stat but also has some RNG to it included. Enemy variation is big enough to not feel like you run into the same enemies over and over while different areas have a focus on specific enemy types. Your characters will get stressed and once too stressed, things could go 180 and make a run more complicated. With how much RNG is included within passives, status effects, and many more, the runs you expect to be easy may still turn something into results not expected, making it fun despite you doing these runs constantly.

Difficulty for the game is to me in the mid-levels, some enemies being on the comfier side to deal with while some will give you some headaches. Bosses do something annoying and even nasty, learning about those things when encountering those. And given a character's death is permanent, you have to make the right decisions whether to continue or be safe and bail out of a dungeon before worse happens. The game plays a lot of mind games with you and your decisions, but I didn't feel anything was overly difficult to even unfair. You can adapt to situations and areas with the right setups so things will get easier if you know what you do.

What increased my experience by a lot is how much the modding scene has to offer for the game. I only knew a few skins for classes to exist which were the reason why I got mildly interested in DD in the beginning, but once I saw what options I have and what modders created over the last decade, I've found a lot of visual changes which made the game a feast for my eyes. New classes, skins for those, many ways to tweak your game and experience it with a new touch. Not to mention that you can tweak a few things by yourself rather easy once figuring out which files are for what. I've made a few changes to my NPCs myself, and will surely do more of that in the future.

Negatives about the game? The usual easy to learn, and hard to master mentality comes into play for sure. It took some hours to get a gist of how to operate my runs, what options I have to make them a bit comfier, and what can wreck you and what to look out for.
I personally felt that the passives you may get after a successful run more often than not went into the negatives, receiving more bad passives over good ones, but there's eventually a mod to balance that out a bit more. Not sure if it's intended like that but felt a bit more geared towards receiving some bad passives, but could just be me not having the best luck with those.
Expect to curse a lot when your 90%+ hit chances end up in missing enemies, or you getting smacked into dangerous levels out of nowhere which can be funny in a grim way~

I'm usually not much into roguelikes, but the combination of how I can tweak the game to my liking plus the bit I've seen and knew about the game got me into giving it a try. Which resulted in my little issue to pick from a very few roguelikes to play whenever time and mood allows it to now being settled into these dungeons. To me, there's no real finish to the game, a lot of things you can do and also add with the help of mods to have a reason to come back whenever you desire. And when on sale, it's just a few bucks which is a lot you get out for such little investment. I like my games with clear goals and beating them, but this game is now fully accepted by me to come back to and enjoy the game.

Spectacular DLCs that expand on the already great game, very innovative stress/affliction system that can lead to characters acting on their own or ignore your commands.
Basically after Darkest Dungeon happened, no other turn base tactics game will ever be the same. It's like Binding of Isaac for roguelikes, or Slay the Spire for deckbuilders.

review:
An agonizingly suffocating, sluggish and slow game. I have played many turn-based games, but they usually at least have some kind of pacing. Here, every dungeon has to be cleared multiple times - yes, they added a roguelike concept - because your heroes get scared, fall into depression, die and so on.

But the point is that roguelikes are usually dynamic and there is no problem killing or running past the same enemy, since in games like Dead Cells or Rogue Legacy you can run through an entire level in literally a couple of minutes. Here, a single battle can easily take 3-5 minutes due to SLOOOW actions and SLOOOOOOOOW animations for every single action.

I tried, I honestly tried. But no. It is like playing marathon battles in War Thunder over and over again - after playing, you are left with only a feeling of exhaustion, weariness and disappointment. And that is not even mentioning the town upgrade grind, resource gathering for building construction and so on.

I would rather replay BG3 yet again and look at that octopus once more than launch this one more time (x_x)

review:
It's not bad but certainly not elite and on balance I unfortunately have to not recommend it. It feels like a much worse 'Slay the Spire' minus the deck-building. After a while, it gets a bit repetitive and boring: the same passages, rewards and enemies... Yes you build up to fighting different bosses but there wasn't quite enough variety to keep me hooked - Slay the Spire manages this way better. 

I also feel like it isn't balanced correctly. The whole premise is that your decisions are permanent so your 'favourite heroes' die if you make a mistake - but at the same time you have a near infinite supply of new heroes who you don't even have to pay to recruit. As such, the stakes don't feel nearly as high the game suggests. Also, all the heroes are basically different skins of the same type of hero. If you boil down their abilities, they're all quite similar: all of them have some combination of healing, de-stealthing, multi-target attack and single-target attack. I've never built my roster and thought: wow I definitely need this type of hero in it... All in all, it's probably worth giving a go if discounted but certainly not at full price.

review:
I love this game, I really do, but no matter how much love I pour into it, it does not make it any less broken. The beginning of the game is excellent: nice, steady progression, good challenge, gradual level ups. The transition from apprentice to veteran is tough but surmountable, and I was having a great time. And then you hit champion level. The characters levels cap at 6, along with their armor and attack capabilities, and if the monsters in the new area were just harder hitting and had more effects with their attacks, that would be fine. Instead, the balance is utterly ruined by massively buffing their dodge and crit rate. 

The game changes completely from a challenging but fair experience that requires planning, forethought, and skill, and turns into a lottery roll. You go into champion dungeons just crossing your fingers that you don't run into monsters with attacks that crit nearly every time, attacks that can and will OHKO multiple party members in one swing, and so on. And these are NOT bosses. These are random enemy encounters where a 75% chance to hit equates to missing five times in a row, then having the enemy critical hit multiple characters in one turn and deathblow them before you can even blink.

Now I know there are people out there that love this, and I'm glad there are because everyone deserves a game that hits just right for them. Unfairness is a genuine appeal to some players, and that's okay, but if that is not something that appeals to you, don't play this game. Don't sink hours into it only to get two thirds of the way in and be completely stonewalled by RNG.

I'm sure a lot of people would laugh at this review and say "if you don't like challenge, then this isn't the game for you" but in my opinion, challenge and RNG are complete opposites. Challenge is something that requires skill to overcome. There is no way to overcome RNG. There is no combat tactic that will stop a crit sweep. There is no prior planning that can mitigate losing your vital trinkets that you cannot ever get back. That's not challenge, and it's not fun for me. If I wanted to play an RNG game that I will always lose, I'd buy a lottery ticket. As for DD, I think I need to just uninstall it. At least I had some fun before it shot itself in the foot.

review:
This may not be the best dungeon crawler, best roguelike, or best turn based games I've played.
However, this game has one of the best themes, and it sticks to it like glue.
The story, albeit simple, glued me to this game for my first 5-10 hours.

I now play it an hour a day, do a few runs, and move on. This game respects your time thats for sure.
Its hard, sometimes hair pulling hard, but not the hardest.
There is plenty of room to learn mechanics, counters, so on.

The game has flaws, all games do, but this game is just so catching.
Its one of my favourites, its soundtrack is godly, and its atmosphere is second to none. (also a good avenue into lovecraftian lore/horror)
The opening has lived rent free in my brain since I first seen it, and I unironically make quotes of the narrator when playing other games. 

Maybe do what I do and have this as a "secondary playthrough" game, where you take breaks from your main games to chip away a few dungeon runs into this one, I promise you the change of pace is a great palate cleanser.
That's specially the case if you are starting to feel burnt out of the potential grind, or just feel the need to take a break, Its very likely unique enough from whatever you are playing beside it.

All in all I think this game is amazing, I do not much care for its DLCs, most have been not the best: I either dislike them or have no opinion on them.
But this game, Darkest Dungeon, is amazing and worth the try. Either as your new game to be hooked on, or a new side hustle to chip away while you grind other games, either way its a great time.

我们的家族没落了...
简要的说，暗黑地牢是一款风格独特的，要在红钩刻意甚至恶意的游戏设计下带领英雄探索地牢击败敌人（或者被敌人击败）的高难度回合制游戏。同时压力系统与老祖魔性的配音从内到外都使得这款游戏与众不同，绝境之下绽放美德的瞬间足以影响屏幕前的玩家（绽放暴虐绝望恐惧偏执自私时也是）。
我的天哪，甚至还有PVP和无尽模式以及一整个庞大的，不断产出各种从新饰品，新英雄职业乃至地区扩展新鲜内容的MOD社区，你还能要求什么呢？

review:
173.7小时(仅steam记录),3个周目，极暗，10年。
第1周目，盗版测试版，海湾还没出，打了十几小时玩不明白，弃了。
第2周目，开始steam记录，冠军区域boss打了一半多，手贱开庭院，被铺天盖地无法处理的血疫和狂信者逼到绝路，死档。
第3周目，用尽各种手段，尽量不死人不解雇人，220周完成，仓库里装满了财宝，祖产和饰品，望着月光下的小镇，怅然若失。

地牢是个好游戏。
双血条管理，艰难的开局，优秀的资源管理、高昂的成本，4大地区，无数的陷阱，奇物，各具特色的boss，渲染到极致的气氛，简单又令人深思的剧情，优秀的美术，马车声、钟声、铁门声、酒吧木门声、英雄们的跃跃欲试、欢乐、警惕、呓语、恐惧、疯魔，绝境中的美德，暴击，好的点太多太多.......

地牢是个坏游戏。
高昂的养成成本，永久死亡的沉重代价，无处不在的凶恶怪物、压力、红癖、血疫、疾病、随时会翻车的可能、恶性滚雪球、不解包看攻略难以察觉的种种机制，庭院超长但大量素材复用的屎尿级地图，极慢的演出速度，以及无处不在的焦躁、绝望和紧迫感，进去4个，疯了5个不只是口头说说，而是每个初见地牢人必定会感受到的真实体验。
随着探索的深入，屏幕前的我也越来越不择手段。
为了减少因不熟悉机制造成的损失，开始看各种机制攻略。
因为搞不清淹没船员怎么打而手足无措，开始看boss分析。
因为被猩红庭院和dd3的超长本折磨而失去耐心，开始找迷宫地图。
因为嫌演出太慢打了加速mod。
最终确实通关了，但并不是完全靠自己，最原初的体验通关的，总有一种难以言说的焦躁感。

地牢与我
有人说，地牢是个资本家游戏，英雄都是打工仔，能用就用，维护成本高了就放弃。
可现实中，我们普通人不也和这些英雄一样吗，为了生存、为了理想，摸爬滚打，一想到这，我就狠不下心。
所以我尽力对待每一场战斗，关注每个英雄的红癖，压力，成长，宁肯多打几十个周目都不愿放弃任何人。
我为每一位为我战死的英雄叹息。
虽然这确实浪费了很多现实中的时间和精力，并且得不偿失。
但我觉得，他们值得。
我真心感谢在第3周目为我战死的29名英雄，存活到结尾的34名英雄，被我解雇的、以及前2周目的无名英雄们。
这或许不是最完美的体验，但已经是我目前拼劲全力最好的体验。

在游玩地牢的过程中，我不只一次有强烈的丧失感。
当满血破盾者被树干猛击暴击清空血条和随之而来的dot致死时，我因想到人生不如意十之八九，厄运随时可能不打招呼而来叹息。
当一个boss,一个地图在不看攻略困难重重，看攻略后轻松解决时，我因想到自己人生常常抹黑走路，无人指导，拼尽全力，收益颇微，一路走来，冷暖自知而折磨。
当好不容易通关时，我为那绝望的终局，以及人生终将到来的疯狂和死亡而焦虑。
我们的人生或许有光芒，但黑暗无处不在。
为了生存，我们必须戴着面具演戏，在迷失、病痛、压力、衰老、疾病中走向不可避免的死亡。
我这一生如履薄冰，你说，我能走到对岸吗？

暗黑地牢最初的发行时间是2016年，十年前啊，那时候的世界是什么样的？那时候的环境又是什么样的？所以在现在看来，这个10年前的老古董游戏不符合主流，也是很正常的，而很多人玩不惯，也是无法避免的。但是暗黑地牢强就强在，即使它有这么多的劝退之处，依然有人对这个游戏爱得深沉，这就不得不归功于其独特的美术设计，用看似粗糙的画风展现触动人心的克苏鲁背景，另外二当家帅麻了谁懂

总之，如果你追求快速的正面反馈、并且不希望收获负面情绪的话，那暗黑地牢确实不适合你，也请你在下四疯五的红温之余多骂骂游戏，而不要气伤了自己，之后该卸载卸载，该退坑退坑。毕竟人生已经这么难了，没必要为了一款游戏折磨自己。但如果你在痛定思痛之余，愿意再次鼓起勇气，向着最后的极暗地牢发起挑战，向着这个支离破碎的世界发起挑战，那么迪斯马和雷纳德会永远在老路等你

许多人或将陷入惶恐与混乱，但绝非此人，绝非此刻

已经离开的人是放弃了战斗，留下的人是有想要守护的东西，而重新回来的你，是在认清了残酷的现实之后，依然选择发出那声不屈的怒吼：

我认识你，你战胜不了我

致所有坚持到底的地牢玩家，已经，这扫码游戏是真他妈上头

review:
[b]【等打折】操控四人小队下地牢，讲究站位的回合制战斗很精巧，哥特恐怖的世界、美术和结局也很迷人。但英雄会承受压力，阵亡后还得补员、重新培养；我借助攻略和减负 MOD 通关，仍觉得反复刷资源、重练队伍很累。喜欢钻研配队和经营的值得玩，讨厌这些重复劳动的慎买。[/b]

[i]踏入庄园的最初时刻——[/i]

低沉的声音从阴影里传来，仿佛早已知晓我的下场。畸变、腐化的轮廓在黑暗中显露，我却只想再靠近一点，看清它们深处藏着什么。好奇心已经替我迈出了第一步。

[h1]刀锋的秩序[/h1]

战斗自有其严苛的秩序。[b]双方各四个站位，技能的释放位置、目标范围都有严格限制。[/b]

麻风剑客的“挥砍”只能从己方前两位攻击敌方前两位，被推到后排就使不上。推拉改变可攻击的目标，眩晕让目标错过行动。队伍必须在这些限制中寻找配合。

我能欣赏这份精巧。坐在屏幕前，感到的却只有提心吊胆。

麻风剑客在要命的时候挥空，神秘学者在要命的时候奶不起来。[b]“命运重构”升满了依然可能奶零，还可能让目标流血。[/b]指望它救回濒死的队员，就是把命交给命运。

局面一失控，我就非常火大，反复用左手横向揉眼睛和太阳穴。挫败感占满脑子。

[pullquote]战斗结束，队员尚存。那才是我的乐趣：我又亲手从古神那里，暂时吊住了一条生命。[/pullquote]
[h1]这条生命，造价不菲[/h1]

我把一个主力英雄养到六级、升满技能、锁定好怪癖，得花数小时的心血和大量资金。他仍然可能死。

[b]损失严重之后，又得招人、整队，带新人下低级本，重复刷钱和传家宝。[/b]死者留下的空位，只能用更多时间填满。

治疗、建筑升级、出征补给，都在消耗资源。锁住“精准打击”“反应快速”这样的好怪癖，要花钱；移除固化的负面怪癖，更贵。队伍崩盘、钱袋干瘪的时候，城镇里每一笔开销都格外沉重。

骨灰盒、书架、祭坛，也值得提防。一次轻率的触碰，可能换来疾病、压力和新的治疗开销。该带什么补给，该碰什么东西，都得学。地牢连好奇心也要收费。

个别物件交互结果：
[spoiler]“装饰瓮”里装着死者的骨灰。徒手摸可能中毒、染病，用圣水清理能找到财物。书架可能改变怪癖、提供地图，也可能增加压力。向“跛行者”祭坛献上火炬，则会召来怪物。[/spoiler]

于是我频繁按 Alt+Tab，向攻略寻求指引。攻略帮我理清需要什么、接下来做什么。目标定了，我就能专心推进，少耗费一些心力。

我也借助减负 MOD，加快战斗和行走速度、增加资源获取量、提高物品堆叠数量、扩充背包、去掉某些负面效果。

资源忽然丰厚，起初很爽。很快，那份畅快消退，熟悉的重复又回来了。

支撑我玩到通关的，仍是对世界、剧情和结局的兴趣。庄园还有秘密，我想看个明白。

[h1]庄园的粉饰[/h1]

正式冒险之前，我还给庄园做过美术装修。

创意工坊非常丰富。新增职业或引入新机制的 MOD，我嫌重新学习麻烦。我喜欢替换原有素材，把城镇 NPC 和手下佣兵换成漂亮妹妹。造型比较清凉，对领主比较坦诚的那种。

有些作者的本事令人佩服。加入更大胆的视觉元素后，仍守住了原版粗粝的黑墨线条与压抑色调。衣料可以省，阴影一笔也没少。

安装的苦工，得自己做。部分可选版本要手动找图片、改名、覆盖。我听着周杰伦的歌，一个一个换文件，枯燥地折腾了好几天，才开始玩。

漂亮立绘让我更舍不得她们死，也抚平过一部分烦躁。面容足以安慰领主，剑锋与治疗照旧听命于骰子。

[h1]领主的冷酷[/h1]

我原本喜欢有塑造、有羁绊的同伴。庄园教给我的，是如何使用耗材。最初死人会心疼，死得多了，心疼便退下了。培养投入和补员成本，接管了我的判断。

“上一支小队的覆灭”“强盗为同伴断后”，都能脑补成小说。屏幕前的我却很清楚，自己只是在算怎样能少亏一点。

旁白会说：
[quote]“一个聪明的将军会减少损失，然后重振旗鼓。”[/quote]
我就这样学会了领主的冷酷。

[h1]通关后的得失[/h1]

通关时，我觉得非常值。结局带来的震动，足以压过一路的疲惫。

[b]如今冷静下来，再看那些重复刷取、重新培养的时间，我又觉得代价太高。[/b]

我依然超级喜欢它的世界、美术和结局。[b]强烈推荐给愿意钻研的硬核玩家，以及愿意花时间找 MOD 的普通玩家。[/b]

代价已经摆在这里。要不要付，由你决定。

[hr][/hr]
[h1]以下涉及后期机制和结局剧透[/h1]

[spoiler]在“极暗地牢”中撤退，会随机选出一名英雄牺牲。我会为了保住剩下的人接受这个代价。这份损失计算，与领主的冷酷贪婪很契合。我个人不喜欢把人当耗材，仍认为这种契合做得极好。

到了“黑暗之心”面前，技能“到汝之造物主身边来”让玩家亲手点选一位英雄承受致死攻击。死者由我指定，账目由我结清。我印象里，这些耗材忽然一个个表现得像英雄。

核对官方台词后，发现他们的反应各不相同。
十字军说：“不洁的邪恶！我要和你同归于尽！”
驯犬师安抚自己的狗：“冷静，姑娘。如果叫到了我们，我们回应就是。”
瘟疫医生喊：“不要选我！我是个博学的学者！”
修女则是：“这……这太可怕了！不！！！！！”

那场告别当时打动了我。回头想，我早已习惯按培养和替换成本看待他们。告别忽然要求我感受更多，显得有些突兀。

结局开口就是：
“胜利。多么卑鄙又可笑的说法。”

黑暗之心既是生命的源头，也是最终的毁灭者。人类只是“离经叛道的血肉”，由它而生，也将回到它之中。脚下的泥土与岩石，是它脆弱的外壳。群星再度排列，它还会苏醒、破壳而出。耗尽无数生命，只让灭亡暂时迟来。

祖先让你担起“毫无意义的看守之责”，片尾又响起：“……我们的家族，没落了。”开场的召唤，在结尾再次回响。我也被留在这个循环里。[/spoiler]

[i]求知欲凿开深渊，贪婪把诅咒留给后人。我们耗尽生命与时日，宇宙仍旧沉默。[/i]

低沉的声音从阴影里传来，仿佛早已知晓我的下场。畸变、腐化的轮廓在黑暗中显露，我却只想再靠近一点，看清它们深处藏着什么。好奇心已经替我迈出了第一步。 [h1]刀锋的秩序[/h1] 战斗自有其严苛的秩序。[b]双方各四个站位，技能的释放位置、目标范围都有严格限制。[/b] 麻风剑客的“挥砍”只能从己方前两位攻击敌方前两位，被推到后排就使不上。推拉改变可攻击的目标，眩晕让目标错过行动。队伍必须在这些限制中寻找配合。 我能欣赏这份精巧。坐在屏幕前，感到的却只有提心吊胆。 麻风剑客在要命的时候挥空，神秘学者在要命的时候奶不起来。[b]“命运重构”升满了依然可能奶零，还可能让目标流血。[/b]指望它救回濒死的队员，就是把命交给命运。 局面一失控，我就非常火大，反复用左手横向揉眼睛和太阳穴。挫败感占满脑子。 [pullquote]战斗结束，队员尚存。那才是我的乐趣：我又亲手从古神那里，暂时吊住了一条生命。[/pullquote] [h1]这条生命，造价不菲[/h1] 我把一个主力英雄养到六级、升满技能、锁定好怪癖，得花数小时的心血和大量资金。他仍然可能死。 [b]损失严重之后，又得招人、整队，带新人下低级本，重复刷钱和传家宝。[/b]死者留下的空位，只能用更多时间填满。 治疗、建筑升级、出征补给，都在消耗资源。锁住“精准打击”“反应快速”这样的好怪癖，要花钱；移除固化的负面怪癖，更贵。队伍崩盘、钱袋干瘪的时候，城镇里每一笔开销都格外沉重。 骨灰盒、书架、祭坛，也值得提防。一次轻率的触碰，可能换来疾病、压力和新的治疗开销。该带什么补给，该碰什么东西，都得学。地牢连好奇心也要收费。 个别物件交互结果： [spoiler]“装饰瓮”里装着死者的骨灰。徒手摸可能中毒、染病，用圣水清理能找到财物。书架可能改变怪癖、提供地图，也可能增加压力。向“跛行者”祭坛献上火炬，则会召来怪物。[/spoiler] 于是我频繁按 alt+tab，向攻略寻求指引。攻略帮我理清需要什么、接下来做什么。目标定了，我就能专心推进，少耗费一些心力。 我也借助减负 mod，加快战斗和行走速度、增加资源获取量、提高物品堆叠数量、扩充背包、去掉某些负面效果。 资源忽然丰厚，起初很爽。很快，那份畅快消退，熟悉的重复又回来了。 支撑我玩到通关的，仍是对世界、剧情和结局的兴趣。庄园还有秘密，我想看个明白。 [h1]庄园的粉饰[/h1] 正式冒险之前，我还给庄园做过美术装修。 创意工坊非常丰富。新增职业或引入新机制的 mod，我嫌重新学习麻烦。我喜欢替换原有素材，把城镇 npc 和手下佣兵换成漂亮妹妹。造型比较清凉，对领主比较坦诚的那种。 有些作者的本事令人佩服。加入更大胆的视觉元素后，仍守住了原版粗粝的黑墨线条与压抑色调。衣料可以省，阴影一笔也没少。 安装的苦工，得自己做。部分可选版本要手动找图片、改名、覆盖。我听着周杰伦的歌，一个一个换文件，枯燥地折腾了好几天，才开始玩。 漂亮立绘让我更舍不得她们死，也抚平过一部分烦躁。面容足以安慰领主，剑锋与治疗照旧听命于骰子。 [h1]领主的冷酷[/h1] 我原本喜欢有塑造、有羁绊的同伴。庄园教给我的，是如何使用耗材。最初死人会心疼，死得多了，心疼便退下了。培养投入和补员成本，接管了我的判断。 “上一支小队的覆灭”“强盗为同伴断后”，都能脑补成小说。屏幕前的我却很清楚，自己只是在算怎样能少亏一点。 旁白会说： [quote]“一个聪明的将军会减少损失，然后重振旗鼓。”[/quote] 我就这样学会了领主的冷酷。 [h1]通关后的得失[/h1] 通关时，我觉得非常值。结局带来的震动，足以压过一路的疲惫。 [b]如今冷静下来，再看那些重复刷取、重新培养的时间，我又觉得代价太高。[/b] 我依然超级喜欢它的世界、美术和结局。[b]强烈推荐给愿意钻研的硬核玩家，以及愿意花时间找 mod 的普通玩家。[/b] 代价已经摆在这里。要不要付，由你决定。 [hr][/hr] [h1]以下涉及后期机制和结局剧透[/h1] [spoiler]在“极暗地牢”中撤退，会随机选出一名英雄牺牲。我会为了保住剩下的人接受这个代价。这份损失计算，与领主的冷酷贪婪很契合。我个人不喜欢把人当耗材，仍认为这种契合做得极好。 到了“黑暗之心”面前，技能“到汝之造物主身边来”让玩家亲手点选一位英雄承受致死攻击。死者由我指定，账目由我结清。我印象里，这些耗材忽然一个个表现得像英雄。 核对官方台词后，发现他们的反应各不相同。 十字军说：“不洁的邪恶！我要和你同归于尽！” 驯犬师安抚自己的狗：“冷静，姑娘。如果叫到了我们，我们回应就是。” 瘟疫医生喊：“不要选我！我是个博学的学者！” 修女则是：“这……这太可怕了！不！！！！！” 那场告别当时打动了我。回头想，我早已习惯按培养和替换成本看待他们。告别忽然要求我感受更多，显得有些突兀。 结局开口就是： “胜利。多么卑鄙又可笑的说法。” 黑暗之心既是生命的源头，也是最终的毁灭者。人类只是“离经叛道的血肉”，由它而生，也将回到它之中。脚下的泥土与岩石，是它脆弱的外壳。群星再度排列，它还会苏醒、破壳而出。耗尽无数生命，只让灭亡暂时迟来。 祖先让你担起“毫无意义的看守之责”，片尾又响起：“……我们的家族，没落了。”开场的召唤，在结尾再次回响。我也被留在这个循环里。[/spoiler] review:
垃圾新手引导，傻逼游戏。
Edit：继续品鉴十个小时后没有产生任何改观。引导的缺失不仅体现在新手教程中，也体现在每一场战斗中。可以针对性地调整战略，但说白了设计上就是先给玩家喂屎，喂两口之后让玩家自己去找避开粪坑的方法，而且脱战直接逃离粪坑不仅有高概率失败还会直接给予惩罚。而整个游戏的流程就是不断重复这个强行喂屎，玩家一边恶心一边捏着鼻子吃惩罚避开粪坑的过程。
暗黑地牢是我10000小时游戏时长当中接触过的最烂的游戏。武断点说的话，这游戏能有如此好的社区评价最大原因或许是美工设计还算优秀。除此之外，游戏过程中几乎没有任何乐趣可言，是一部充满恶意的坐牢模拟器。

review:
**Rust: The Only Game Where Trust Issues Are a Survival Skill. 😂🔥**

Rust isn't just a game. It's an emotional roller coaster disguised as a survival simulator.

You start with a rock, a torch, and big dreams. A few hours later, you've built a fortress, collected enough loot to feel like a king, and convinced yourself you're finally safe. Then some naked guy with a spear reminds you that nothing in Rust belongs to you. You're just borrowing it until someone raids you. 😂

The PvP is intense, the base building is addictive, and the adrenaline rush when you're carrying a full inventory of loot back to your base is unmatched. Every encounter is a gamble. Every alliance is questionable. And every friendly voice outside your door is probably plotting something.

I've played plenty of games, but Rust hits differently. It's brutal, unpredictable, hilarious, frustrating, and somehow keeps you coming back for more.

**10/10 — Would lose everything, question humanity, and rebuild again.**

Trust nobody. Protect your loot. And remember... offline doesn't mean safe. ☠️🔥

review: Rust scratches an itch that no other PvP game can. I genuinely love playing this game, but it desperately needs another serious performance overhaul. It's honestly amazing how a game that's been around for this long still struggles to push past 60–100 FPS on most servers unless you're running a newer CPU or one with 3D V-Cache. I can play plenty of other modern titles and comfortably push 150–200+ FPS, yet Rust is one of the only games I play where I'm lucky to consistently break 120 FPS. And apparently, because my CPU doesn't have that magical "3D cache," I'm just out of luck.What's even more frustrating is that it feels like nearly every major update makes performance progressively worse. I understand Rust is a demanding game, especially with large maps, massive player counts, and player-built structures, but at some point, optimization needs to become a bigger priority.I'm not expecting 300+ FPS on a populated server, but I also don't think it's unreasonable to expect consistently good performance on hardware that's still more than capable of running modern games.Please, Face punch, give Rust the performance overhaul it desperately needs. I'd love to enjoy this game without having to sell my organs on the black market just to afford a new motherboard, ram and CPU.I love Rust, but I shouldn't need to build an entirely new PC every few years just to keep up with its declining performance. (This is also the reason I don't have more hours because my performance is so unbelievably terrible that it makes it really unfun to play)

越更新越是依托，更是在毫无征兆，我都退游一两年的情况下，今天我上steam给我弹小黄信，给我EAC了，挂这么多你制裁不了，就开始无差别攻击是吧，无能的官方，你不然就把国区锁了呗，说句实话我一点都不觉得可惜，也玩了一千多个小时了，只是想说句RNM退钱，我也懒得申诉了，真的是狗焯的官方。
The more updates there are, the more it relies on it, and it’s completely without warning. I hadn’t played for a year or two, and today I logged into Steam and got a little yellow message and got EAC banned. You can’t punish all the cheaters, so you just start attacking everyone indiscriminately, huh, worthless officials? Why don’t you just lock the game in the Chinese region instead? Honestly, I don’t feel regret at all, I’ve played over a thousand hours anyway. Just wanted to say RNM, give me a refund.

Беспомощные админы, ну тогда уж заблокируйте регион полностью. Честно говоря, мне вообще не жаль, я поиграл больше тысячи часов, просто хочу сказать RNM верните деньги.

So viele Cheater kannst du nicht bestrafen, also fängst du an, wahllos anzugreifen, oder? Unfähige Entwickler. Dann sperr doch einfach die China-Region. Ehrlich gesagt finde ich das überhaupt nicht schade, ich habe sowieso schon über tausend Stunden gespielt. Wollte nur mal sagen: RNM, Geld zurück.

今天我跟我的外国网友一起去外服组队游玩。然后。玩了没一会儿，我的游戏就显示被开发者Easy Anti-Cheat给永久封禁了。我是开挂了还是咋地？我才玩了三个小时，你让我开挂我也不会呀而且，因为我内存运行内存不太够，所以我捣鼓了半天，终于进游戏，才玩了没一会儿。然后就被封禁了，还是永久封禁？当我在steam上面收到这个信息的时候，我一脸懵逼。我就想问这个游戏的傻逼开发者，你看到中文名字在服务器里面是很碍你眼吗？我是开挂了还是。咋地了？你就给我。游戏给永久封禁了。傻逼游戏。
Today I played a game with my foreign online friend on an overseas server. After just a short while, the game suddenly showed that I had been permanently banned by the developer Easy Anti-Cheat. Did I cheat or something? I've only played for three hours—how could I possibly hack? Besides, my computer has low RAM, so I struggled to get into the game at all. Finally managed to log in, and barely started playing when I got banned—permanently! When I received this message on Steam, I was completely stunned. I just want to ask this stupid developer: does seeing a Chinese name on the server really bother you that much? Did I do something wrong? Or is it just because of my name? You go ahead and ban me permanently. What a crap game.

9/10: Awesome game!!

I honestly can't believe I haven't left a review for this game yet. My one issue with Terraria is it can be rather grindy at times, especially if you want a specific item or weapon and sometimes the bosses can feel a little unfair when playing by yourself. Other than that, there is a reason it's been around for over 15 years and remains peak. The Villager Npc's feel a lot more than just shopkeepers having histories, lore, and even relationships with the other villagers. (which I love despite making it sometimes hard to plan houses for them all). This is definitely a game to play WITH friends, but can be just as fun with yourself. The vast amount of bosses, and weapons you can use to disperse them are definitely a huge plus, allowing for creative and often absurd solutions that fit for your playing style. 

I won't deny that you likely do need a wiki for progression or crafting while planning as while as cool as this game is, I won't deny that it isn't the most beginner friendly. (Personally I like that though). I feel it has a lot to offer, whether its building beautiful castles and creations, or battling against cosmic entities, or a fishing sim, there is something for everyone!

review:
Simply put, Terraria is one of if not the most enjoyable action sandbox game money can buy.
To explain the rough idea of Terraria it runs off of player curiosity and the natural urge to explore new things, you'll find yourself asking "What's this? or "Who's that?" or "Does this hurt me?" every moment you play. I'm aware of the turn offs such as "It's too grindy" or "There's no guide to progression" but thats the entire intent of Terraria, it's built for you to learn on your own through exploration, stay in certain areas to kill certain enemies for specific drops needed to progress. In nature this is a grindy and long-winded game but for all the right reasons. I'll keep it concise in a bullet point list as to what Terrarias progression looks like to the average player (my own time played totals to around 1.1k hours on Steam but 2k more on other devices).

Early Game (Pre-Boss):
- Make housing using the beginner tools provided
- Delve into the naturally spawning caves in search of loot
- Further explore each side of your world to find the two important early parts of Terraria (the jungle and the dungeon - they spawn on opposite sides of the world to each other - the jungle side towards the end near the ocean has an important but not necessary biome deep underground known as the shimmer, search it up if you want a deeper look)
- Prepare arenas for upcoming bosses and events

Mid Pre-Hardmode (Post Eye/Evil Boss/Queen Bee):
- Talk to that guy you may have met at the dungeon and summon his curse with your well-earned gear
- Explore the dungeons depths once you have beaten Skeletron
- Search the gold chests with the gold key drops (can drop from dungeon pots, dungeon enemies, dungeon slimes most commonly or rarely wood chests in the dungeon)
- Grab your dungeon loot alongside the possibility of an obsidian key to unlock those locked chests in hell if you've stumbled into there yet
- Grab your hell loot from the chests and build a long platform in hell, you're gonna need it

End Pre-Hardmode:
- Find a guide voodoo doll dropped from voodoo demons in hell into a pocket of lava, if you can't get this to drop make a house for the guide to move in just above hell and cause him to fall into lava in hell
- Kill the Wall of Flesh and you're officially halfway through the game (at least in my eyes)

时间是在2026年6月10日的一个普通下午，抖音的推流机制让我莫名其妙地刷到双影奇境隐藏关卡。
故事就这样开始了，打招呼，寒暄，到开始攻略隐藏关卡，折腾了好几个小时，但是结果有些挫败，可能是配合的不够熟练，隐藏关卡没有过去，之后的故事又开始变得不一样了，从她的一句茶杯头打到哪里，彼时的我也刚好在玩，话题一下子变得多样起来，从没打过去的隐藏关到茶杯头，到茶杯头通关，她变成了我的双人游戏搭子。
让人红温的双影奇境的隐藏关被放到了一边，两个人从茶杯头到胡闹厨房到杯杯倒满，还有保持通话没人爆炸，到我们曾在此永远等等双人游戏。

愿每个可爱的人，都可以和挚爱之人玩一遍泰拉瑞亚。

review: 应该是八年前第一次看到有人玩这个，打世花，瞟了眼玩法和画风，大为震撼，但是当时电脑，主机什么设备之类的概念也不懂，一直没找到这个游戏；六年前偶然发现某国服代理，因为没钱买激活码，每次2h试玩。虽然是阉割版，但结束后我都意犹未尽；两年后有人告诉我1.3上线。学习版体验了两遍通关，这种完整的故事背景、游戏规则和递进的难度，真的对我的学习、理解和想象能力都有很大启发与帮助。借当时没汉化的版本和查Wiki练出来的读文字能力，班上英语小测，从原来70分稳定考到85分，再到升学96分；后来心动代理，自己补张票，还给两个同学买了票。可惜大家没时间玩，白嫖我的票，又没玩几个小时就跑了（都说游戏很好，一个受不了像素游戏，一个学习能力不足找不到游戏工作台制造按钮）；到自己有电脑以后，买了四人份票，本来以为手机版就是全部了，直到看到这个手机基本上渲染不出来的地牢新增地形，我感觉自己以前白玩了。这个游戏真的每玩一次都有不一样的新体验，而且它的更新总能跟新到点子上，真的佩服策划。沙盒类游戏，这个可以和其它四大一起并列第二了，第一是永远是一起玩的朋友，虽然一起玩的时间很短暂。（暗示玩家只有两类，能玩Terraria和不能玩Terraria的。千里马常有而伯乐不常有，太多人太浮躁，以为电竞和网游才是游戏，Terraria存档开个头就以为是全部，就跑了，浪费老子快六张票。）

review:
Thank you for giving a disgruntled Pokémon fan what Nintendo never could

This game blends creature collection, survival mechanics and exploration wonderfully, and the progression feels pretty good outside of the late game technology point grind. All of the systems, though some can certainly be a pain at first (climate, food decay, weapon repairs), can all be managed reasonably or mitigated somewhat through abilities and items. The base creation, while seemingly limited at first due to the small size of the given building space, takes off once you realize the vertical potential. However, some of the bigger pals clip through tight rooms and areas, which can be a little off-putting at best, and downright criminal at worst. (the pals can get very large)

Overall, while I am not completely finished with the game, I've enjoyed it significantly more than I thought I would, and I absolutely recommend it to anyone who enjoyed Pokémon in the past, as well as anyone else interested.

review: While this might be the best "pokemon-style" game around, the game itself is largely a disappointment. It's a matter of too much and too little at the same time. There might be hundreds of pals, but most of them are elemental variations on pals you've already seen. There might be a huge landmass to discover, but most of it isn't worth taking the time to fully explore. There might be lots of dungeons, but they're only a handful of layouts and skins for them, so it's mostly an exercise in repetition. There's a huge tech tree to explore, but you'll find little reason to actually unlock most of it. By the time my wife and I got through with the world tree stuff, we STILL hadn't tackled many of the summoned boss fights, or the harder tower fights. It's like the progression of this game is all over the place, and at the end all I could think was, "Was my experience what the game designers intended?" because I felt like I was leaving so much of the game unfinished.

review:
Palworld has been a lot of fun, and I can honestly recommend it if it seems like something you'd enjoy! Base building and crafting are cool, the world is huge and chock-full of stuff (not to mention gorgeous to look at IMO), combat and exploration are fun, and I genuinely love a LOT of the pal designs! It's been a great time, all in all, and the best advice I can give is to not try and play it like a Pokémon game, because it's not supposed to be one - It's meant to be Ark survival.
If you're worried about AI, it's understandable, but I can attest that I haven't found a lick of evidence to ANY AI use in the game or otherwise. The designs look perfectly fine and honestly quite creative to me, and there haven't really been any wonky textures aside from a few low-res cliffs here and there , which kinda just seems more of a graphics thing. And, given how mod-able the game is and the fact that I haven't crashed once, I highly doubt there's any AI in the code either (though I wish I could say the same for a number of workshop mods). And, on top of that, Pocketpair has been strictly non-AI, the only use-case being some art game made by 2 guys at the company, which soon got abandoned and led to their current "No AI" policy.
Overall, I've really enjoyed the game, both before and after 1.0, so if you like base building, exploration, and cool creatures, I'd say give it a shot!

review:
There is so much I love about Palworld.

It’s a complete one-time purchase without the relentless live-service grind—no forced daily chores, time gates, or paywalls blocking features - I’m so tired of that model. You just buy it and play at your own pace.

The world customization is awesome. You can tweak almost every server setting and difficulty slider across different worlds, whether you want a relaxed experience or a brutal survival challenge.

Best of all, I was able to host a dedicated server for my family and friends so we can enjoy the game together.

P.S. To the die-hard Pokémon fans getting salty: a complete lack of competition is the exact reason Nintendo keeps giving you less for more. When there's no rival pushing them, you end up paying full price for mediocre releases. Palworld raising the bar is a good thing.

I was one of those Pokémon fans who kept wishing Nintendo would release something like this, but it never happened until Palworld came around.

真好玩呀。这简直就是我童年梦想中的世界，与形形色色的帕鲁相遇，和它们结为伙伴，共同建造家园，一起探索广袤的未知大陆，踏上揭开尘封谜团与追寻真相的旅程。由衷感谢制作组为我们造出了这样一场美梦。

这游戏很容易拿来和宝可梦作对比,不过实际游玩下来,感觉这游戏的玩法倒更像是方舟生存进化那样,游戏的画风虽然清新可爱,不过游戏的设定剧情就有些嗜血了,不过也好,这样玩家杀伤抢掠起来也没什么心里负担,我觉得还不赖。
最后,游戏体验,我其实没什么好说的,如果你一直不满现在gf制作的宝可梦游戏,又或者是对方舟生存这类游戏感兴趣;但是又不想深度学习就能体验乐趣的,可以来试试。同时不管是单人游玩或朋友一起,我都推荐适度修改下游戏的部分设置,因为里面的某些制作、建造系统太肝太花时间了,只能说打mod消耗游戏寿命,不打mod消耗自身寿命,部分该打就打,这样玩的才舒服。

review:
堆料堆出了质变
[hr]
流程重复但堆出新花样：pal和大部分肝游一样，通过装备、科技的迭代、帕鲁的养成来延缓内容的消费。但不同的是，pal在此基础上引入新的生产机制、堆更多新的地图、堆更多新的帕鲁。凭借堆料还真就维持住了新鲜感。但肝度确实值得商榷，适当使用捷径mod反而能获得更好体验。

别有风味的帕鲁画风：虽然大规模出名的是帕鲁社畜形象，但这也得建立在柔和圆润的风格设计上。虽然算不得多么精细，但也足够讨人喜爱。

持久的内容填充：每次回坑都能看到新的地图、新的帕鲁、新的设备，每次看相关新闻都能听到积极的更新消息。肝游最需要的就是持久的、多样的内容更新，至少目前更新预期还都是积极的。

review:
Praises: 
for a game from a triple A studio this game is filled with a dang good surplus of unique interactions, small details and Easter eggs to explore. 
The honor system allows different players to experience the game differently and gives good replay ability. 
Story is great with a good share of twists and good buildup, characters feel grounded and real. Lenny, Sally and Kieran are some of my personal favorite characters. and seeing the people slowly change over time as a response to the in game events is very fun. 
Also a good aspect of the game is that you can kill members of the KKK and the game rewards you with honor for doing that. 

Critiques:
I do think it struggles a bit from having to many mechanics that aren't fully utilized outside of one or two quests to introduce them. But those introduction quests are at the beginning and all placed really close to each other making the mechanics feel crowded and overbearing to the new player. Satchel upgrades give incentive to engage with hunting but it never really felt that needed, I beat the game without a single one. 
 Another critique is that like many other triple A games it suffers from a lot of character over crowding, Its another game where your character is already a member of a group and has been there for a long time, for that reason all of the individual members are thrown at you one after another and because your character is already canonically acquainted its hard to introduce the player to them in a natural way. Quests don't give time to expand on these characters individually instead having each mission play hot potato on who its focusing on and so most characters are hard to remember especially during the first half of the game. 
Also they killed online.

review:
⭐ Not Recommended – One of the Most Overrated Games I've Ever Played

I genuinely refuse to believe people enjoy playing this game. At this point, I'm convinced the 10/10 reviews are part of some elaborate social experiment.

Let's start with the horse. Apparently, riding a horse requires a fucking PhD. Why does something as simple as travelling from A to B feel like I'm trying to land a Boeing 747? The horse has the intelligence of a potato and controls like it's actively working against me.

The controls are an absolute fucking joke. There are approximately 7,000 different keybinds, none of which seem to have been designed by someone who has actually used a keyboard before. Every five seconds I'm having to Google what button does what because apparently remembering 400 different inputs is now a core gameplay mechanic.

And the tutorial? What tutorial? Apparently Rockstar expects you to absorb the entire control scheme through psychic communication.

Controller aiming is somehow even worse. Trying to shoot something feels like attempting brain surgery while wearing boxing gloves. I want to aim at an enemy, not negotiate a peace treaty with the right analogue stick.

And the graphics? Don't get me wrong, they're decent, but holy shit, you'd think this game was rendering the actual universe with the amount of resources it consumes. My PC is working overtime to deliver an experience that looks nowhere near worth the performance hit.

I keep hearing about this incredible masterpiece, but so far I've experienced:

A horse with the handling characteristics of a shopping trolley.
Controls designed by someone who clearly hates human hands.
Aiming that makes me question whether my controller is broken.
An unnecessary amount of keybinds.
Performance demands that would make NASA reconsider its budget.

Apparently, the story is amazing. Fantastic. Unfortunately, I have to PLAY the game to experience it, and playing it feels like an unpaid administrative job.

I don't care how beautiful the sunsets are or how realistic the horse's testicles supposedly are. If I need a fucking instruction manual to get on a horse and shoot someone, something has gone horribly wrong.

Red Dead Redemption 2: 10/10 cinematic experience, 2/10 actual gameplay experience.

I wanted to play a cowboy game, not become a full-time horse technician with a minor in keyboard memorisation.

I genuinely don't understand the hype.

早有耳闻这作开放世界npc行为的精细度和细腻程度，终于是体会到了，喜欢嘴臭遇到的npc看他们的反应发现台词的种类居然也很多，真是真是太有意思了。
本来对美国西部牛仔（严格意义上来说不算）故事不太感兴趣，但是玩完游戏之后我突然有了那么点兴趣[spoiler] 我觉得做野蛮人也没什么不好的，比起最后救赎到一无所有不如大家一直停留在最好的马掌望台，从第三章开始感觉就不得不和帮派成员告别一切都为了达奇的计划，但是幕后推手果然还是那个时代吧，范德林帮就和剧情里的印第安人一样就这么被所谓的文明碾过去了 [/spoiler]
很喜欢马匹系统每匹马的手感都不一样性格也不一样好爱我的阿拉伯驴TAT虽然你胆子小遇事不对就甩人体型也小还爱怪叫
陌生人支线非常有意思每个地区都有不一样的随机任务，有时候听npc聊聊家常也很有趣[spoiler] 白先生和黑先生关系真好啊 [/spoiler]地图上也有很多精心设置的彩蛋可以记录到日记本里，尾声之前的很多小屋里都有独立的叙事故事供玩家脑补，但是唯一美中不足的大概就是尾声后，游戏后半段开放的大部分地区都非常的荒凉只有风景有一种尾声后故事也就结束了的既视感。

review: 90多块钱买的，里面的西部文化让我非常着迷，复古风格的服装和枪械，尤其是左轮，霰弹这些古典枪械，打击手感非常好。故事情节很好，就是有一些剧情可以再丰满一点，像是DDL赶工期，有些东西很好但有瑕疵。光影效果，画质非常好，是我玩过画质最好的了，也可能是我玩的少。游戏的一大特点就是慢，比如割皮，换弹，家务，骑马上马背，动作细节全部拉满，让你更加沉浸其中。需要静下心来玩，我觉得比较适合学生，或者体制内的人，比较清闲朝九晚五的人来玩，如果没有大块的空闲时间，很难沉浸地深入感受。推荐用手柄玩，键鼠打架更方便但是手柄还是更舒服更沉进，最近考完试开始学手柄操作。手柄暑假前买的，没怎么用过，最近打奥日2学熟练了，用手炳打大表哥，果然更舒服。大表哥好像史低七十多，小黑盒和ST对照着看，说不定GTA6出来了会更便宜。最近也纠结要不要买大表哥1，感觉画质差好多，有着看着反胃的感觉，就那个画风太压抑了。

review:
它不是那种一路爽杀、节奏飞快的游戏，更像一台西部生活模拟器。
赶路要骑马，马会受惊、会累；下雨衣服会湿，踩泥身上会脏；打猎想拿完美皮毛，得小心翼翼，稍微搞砸皮毛就废了。细节细到有点“折磨人”，但也正是这些东西，让这个西部世界活起来了。
 
主线讲范德林德帮的末路，亚瑟这个人真的后劲很大。嘴上嘴硬爱吐槽兄弟，心里藏着善良，一边跟着帮派抢劫度日，一边又在慢慢寻找自己的救赎。打到结局的时候，心里堵得慌，不是打完BOSS的痛快，是看着一个时代、一群人慢慢走向落幕的怅然。
 
缺点也很实在：节奏偏慢，赶路花很多时间，操作动画多，急性子容易不耐烦；线上模式外挂多，只推荐专心玩单机剧情。
 
如果你愿意沉下心，不着急推任务，骑着马沿着河谷看日落、在湖边蹲鹿、在小镇酒馆坐一会，它会给你别的游戏很难给的氛围感。
属于挑人的神作，静下心来玩，才懂它好在哪。

review:
First thing to be said is that this game works really bad on modern RTX cards since the first thing you notice is that skybox and light is flickering. The FPS is kinda low and doesn't change with different presets. So you need to install mods to make it work properly!
From cold Chicago we go to sunny San Francisco. The game changes its tone and it seems both in story and gameplay.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3824930027
The story now feels less serious and depressing which is not bad but also more global. Now we follow not only revenge but we change society. In the first game you was following Aiden's storyline but here I can highlight DedSec as a main character. Marcus in just a part of something bigger while he is still controlled by player. There are several characters that Marcus works and each of them has their own style and attributes that are memorable. 
The game itself is a satire on modern society with AI and Big Brother that is watching your every step which is aged well and actual in 2026.
Gameplaywise this game has better hacking and world interaction than the previous one. Now we can use RC and Drone to solve different riddles and neutralise enemies. Now you can make different gangs fight each other or even call cops on someone you don't like just by getting skill in a skilltree. In this game you have different approach to your enemies: you can hack them through cameras, use drone or RC, just shoot or use environment to neutralise them. 
Also interactions with the world are cool and npcs react on your actions.
One of my favourite things are hacking riddles - there are plenty of them during the story and on the map and many of them make you think.
To be honest shooting is not the strongest part of the game. You don't have slow motion like in the first game and you don't really feel the impact of the guns.
Visuals are incredible sometimes the game looks very realistic and thats the 2016 game!!!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3826472513
Online here is more alive that in the first game and much funnier too! 
I really love this game and if you liked the first one you should try the second part!

review:
Not my favorite game from the series but definitely not the worst one. It looks good, I like how San Francisco looks and how huge it is (it brings me GTA SA memories) and I love the inclusion of drones and car hacks. Of course it has some few missteps I wanna mention.
First, I wanna talk about the story and the characters. I liked the 1st WatchDogs because of its darker tone and more grounded story, not saying that making a more light-hearted story isn't good but I don't feel like WD takes much advantage with this. DedSec's whole motivation of helping people see the corruption is obviously the whole point of the group but it just doesn't feel as impactful or important as they try to make it sound. It becomes uninteresting pretty quick and it doesn't help that Blume and Dusan don't feel like a threat at all during a big chunk of the story and Dusan's appearance as the villains was too obvious during the first minutes of the game. As I just mentioned, Dusan isn't as threatening like Lucky Quinn or Damien for example, even though Ubi tries from time to time to make him look calculated and "unpredictable", all that stuff. The DedSec group isn't fleshed out either. The only one who feels somewhat interesting is Wrench but even he gets beaten up by the writing. Horatio gets killed in one operation and never mourned, nor mentioned ever again throughout the game just because Ubi didn't know how to do with him and T-Bone gets sidelined like crazy and he looks more like a cameo character that deserved to be in a side operation instead. I swear, Clara would laugh off just to see the people who formed DedSec in the first place.
Lastly I wanna talk about some other stuff that I didn't like as much about the game: The money you can make feels nerfed compared to WD1, no upgrades regarding that whatsoever. Sure you have in-game activities that give you money like ridesharing and time trials but they still give you so less. It's like GTA5 all over again. Another thing I didn't like would be the lack of "research" points. Sure, those are scattered around the map but I just finished the game and I still couldn't complete every single nod. Maybe if the upgrade costs were lowered. And speaking of upgrades, I mentioned I like introduction of drones and "rc cars" and car hacks but I also like the fact that we have almost unlimited gadgets, although in a smaller number (only electros shocks, bombs and Blackouts) but why is Blackout useless in this game? Outside of multiplayer, the coolest "ability" in the game gets zero use. Also what happened to ctOS scans after heavy cop chases and the signal jammers? Welp, at least those are getting replaced by a little broken detection system by the enemies and again, car hacks.
I'm not saying WatchDogs 2 is BAD, bad (unlike Legion) but not good either. Just below the first game. And whoever wants to play this game I welcome you.

review: I had high hopes for this game after playing and absolutely loving watchdogs 1 on my ps3 years ago and im glad this game delivers . I did have some issues with the progression for the first 2 hours and the the way the missions were structured seemed confusing at first but the missions start shining after a few hours in , Its a good game overall with decent side content and mission variety without forcing only a hacking playstyle . I had issues with the weapon wheel though , where compared to watchdogs 1 u cant hoard a bunch of weapons and choose any on the field , here u gotta go back to base and swap which seemed unnecessarily hectic . the plot is good and raises important questions and when the game released 10 years ago it mustve been farfetched but in 2026 u hear and see some of these things already happening so its intriguing . i recommend this game to anyone who wants 30-40 hours of fun carefree gameplay without grinding much and a good plot .

review:
Originally played on the PS4 back in 2016, but now there couldn't be a better time to play this game. Especially with all the technology invading privacy nowadays, social media being used to distort people's views, or divide people, corruption in government and corporations, all that stuff. I also LOVE the more light-heartedness of this game, I don't care what anyone else says. I love the characters, the tone, the settings, and all. 

As mentioned by a lot of people, this game is a great open world sandbox too. There's A LOT of creativity in how you can approach a mission or enemy territories. All the gadgets you get, tools, hacks, weapons, all make for a great variety. You can go pure stealth no kills, spam distract and sneak by, spam black outs, hack cars to run enemies over, go on a mayhem and kill everyone, melee takedowns only, non-lethal only, drive explosives into enemies, drop bombs on enemies with the quadcopter, etc. SO SO many options it is genuinely so fun changing your approach each time. 

Also still the most alive feeling open world game I've played to date. I feel less inclined to murder random npcs on the street because of that, same with enemies. There's unique events that happen everywhere in the game, and every npc has a unique profile to them. I'm a Bay Area citizen and they absolutely nailed how San Francisco looks and it's vibes. I couldn't be more happy with it, this game was a gift to me.

review:
Watch_Dogs 2 is a third person open world action/stealth game that takes the few things that were good about the first Watch_Dogs and pumps them up to 11.

The game controls great, the free running is much more fluid, there's tons more side content and just general stuff to do. San Fransisco looks beautiful and it's actually insane how good this game still looks 10 years after release.

The city is more vibrant and has more interesting locales than Watch_Dogs 1 and is really fun to roam around in and find stuff. It reminded me why the "Ubisoft open world" got so popular in the first place - when it's done well, it's a really fun playground!

One of my biggest gripes about Watch_Dogs 1 was the overly edgy writing - this has been toned down in the sequel, albeit it's been replaced with what some might call "millenial cringe". Personally, I found it fun - a real time-capsule of the mid 2010s. The cast is fun and all the personalities are interesting without becoming grating caricatures

Another thing they really improved on in the second game is the stealth. You now have actual options for it and just mowing down a whole compound of enemies is reasonably harder than in the first game. The quadcopter and jumper provide a lot of versatility for approaching encounters and there were some missions that to my great glee I managed to complete without ever setting foot in the restricted area

All in all, if you miss the days when open worlds were cool instead of tiring busy-work, then I suggest getting this game on sale! It's great fun
