review:
[h1]It Takes Two — Couple's Therapy, With Unnecessary Elephant Trauma[/h1]

I'll admit it: I started It Takes Two sceptical.

My usual taste leans towards gritty, realistic, and often brutal games like GTA V, Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order and Survivor, and Detroit: Become Human. So, naturally, this colourful, cartoonish adventure looked like a bit of a departure from my usual gaming diet.

But this was the first co-op game I played with my fiancée, and I'm SO glad I gave it a chance.

[b]THE STORY — MORE THAN JUST A CUTE LITTLE ADVENTURE[/b]

Beneath its colourful art style lies a genuinely heartfelt story about a relationship that's been falling apart for years. It explores love, frustration, resentment, and the difficult process of finding your way back to someone.

What really stood out to both of us was the ending. It doesn't magically fix years of broken trust and accumulated problems just because two people spend a few hours working together. But it shows that those hours can be a beginning. A first step towards something better.

And honestly? That hit harder than I expected from a game featuring talking household objects.

[b]THE GAMEPLAY — TWO BRAINCELLS, ONE OBJECTIVE[/b]

The gameplay is an absolute blast. Every level introduces new mechanics, abilities, and challenges that constantly change how you and your partner need to cooperate. Just when you've mastered one set of mechanics, the game throws something completely different at you.

Communication matters, teamwork matters, and sometimes you will absolutely blame your partner for your own spectacular failure. It's practically relationship counselling with platforming.

And that upside-down section? No spoilers, but we had a great time with that one.

[b]THE ELEPHANT — I WANT A LAWYER[/b]

If you've played it, you know.

If you haven't, I'm not spoiling it.

All I'll say is that I went into this game expecting a wholesome co-op adventure, and I came out carrying emotional damage caused by an elephant.

[b]THE VERDICT[/b]

It Takes Two surprised me in the best possible way. The story is heartfelt, the gameplay constantly stays fresh, and sharing the experience with my fiancée made it all the more special.

You don't need to be a fan of colourful platformers. You don't even need to think this is your kind of game.

Just find someone you love, grab a second controller, and give it a chance.

[b]9/10. One point deducted for the elephant incident. I will never financially or emotionally recover.[/b]

review: 双人游玩的天花板，第一次和一位朋友玩到一半因为对方不喜欢就一直晾在这里了，最近才找到人陪我一起打完，也算是没吃灰，游戏内玩法放在当下也是独具一格，可以说是我第一次见到这么创意性的玩法，不同章节不同能力，也伴随着不同的解密，解密的难度刚刚好，基本上用心玩都很容易发现，难度对于手残档也是友好的，不过可能是每一章的小解密太多，内核不变都是解决几个小解密然后开门打boss，类似这种，稍微几章特别一点。所以长时间游玩会有点累。对于剧情其实我是不太看好的，甚至感觉有点僵硬，完全没有那种双方和解的感觉，也没有感动。剧情方面确实不太好，不过作为一个推动游戏目标的话那我只能说可以拥有。个人排行T1.5

准确来说玩了三遍，第一遍只是为了通关，两个人不管其他的小游戏或者成就什么的，就一直往前走，经过20个小时通关了。
第二遍为了找成就，但是他也没告诉我这个成就在这个小节中间的位置，前边的主线还是需要过，尤其是太空猴子那一段，为了小游戏和成就活生生打了三遍，雪景球里面那个塔也解冻了三次，最后才找到所有的成就和小游戏。
第三遍是为了找小游戏，因为有个成就需要找到所有的小游戏，在阁楼那卡住了，布置舞台那能看到仨小游戏，除了赛车解锁了，剩下的俩看得见上不去，看攻略说能在桌子下面反向跳上去 结果跳了半个小时没成功，老老实实重新打交响乐这一小节。。。。。

[h1] 一直在等一位对的人陪我玩《双人成行》。如今，终于等到了 [/h1]

《双人成行》是合作游戏中一座不容忽视的标杆。只要了解过游戏，大概率都听过它的名字。多年前看到推荐时，我便买下了它，却一直没有开始虽然有同学和舍友问过我，我没有回答默默拒绝。内心一直想等一位合适的人，一起走进这个世界。

如今，终于等到了。虽然还是很期待能并肩坐着一起玩，但开着视频、隔着屏幕通关，也成了一段相当难忘的回忆。

因为游戏买得早，不知道什么时候可以玩，最怕的就是还没玩便被剧透。可惜，中途的[spoiler]大象[/spoiler]和结尾的[spoiler]亲亲[/spoiler]，还是不小心在视频里看到了。也正是因为某些重要情结被剧透，之后我便刻意避开所有相关视频，想把剩下的惊喜留到真正游玩的那一天。好在亲自踏进这个世界时，依然有太多意想不到的设计，让我们一路惊呼、一路笑着玩下去。

review:
More than just a Ghost Hunting Game.

With over 1,000 hours on Xbox and another 400+ hours here on PC, I think it's safe to say Phasmo has become much more than a game to me.

While I do reminisce on the times before the player model update and the [b]plethora[/b] of bugs that came with it, I do hope that the game will continue to take the right steps towards improvements and QoL changes. For now, the game is in a bit of an odd state. Despite that, though, I do heavily recommend this game for casual play.

[h2]Final thoughts?[/h2]
Deogen my beloved. Thank you for getting me through the Gold Apocalypse III challenge.

review: 一款很有意思，很有新意的多人联机的恐怖游戏，在游戏中，玩家需要扮演定鬼师去调查一处闹鬼的地点在猎鬼师进行驱鬼前收集证据，探明鬼魂类型，游戏十分惊险刺激，在鬼房里收集证据，在猎杀时躲避鬼和各种各样的诅咒道具以及很多有趣的彩蛋，并且和朋友一起玩也很有趣，不过游戏的优化不太好，服务器很土豆，并且有些BUG很影响游玩体验，但最大的问题是游戏的等级系统，低等级道具和高等级道具在收集证据的效率和准确性上有很大的差距，导致新手经常会定错鬼而得不到钱和经验，对需要快速升级且没有老玩家带还不敢加入别人房间的新手来说很不友好，所有推荐各位想买的玩家，最好是在游戏打折的时候和朋友一起入

review: 好玩，但是总体来说有好有坏，首先，作为恐怖游戏来讲不算非常恐怖，其恐怖元素主要来源于阴暗氛围，和被追逐时的紧张，如果是一个人玩一段时间就会慢慢习惯，变得没意思，不过要是有朋友一起玩就好的多，好的点是很有新意，玩法上很有意思，通过找证据去判断鬼魂种类。但是想给官方一个建议，同时也给各位需要入坑的玩家一点提醒，这款游戏单人玩并不会有什么影响，但是想多人玩就比较依赖加速器，这个我们都能够理解，毕竟怎么说人家是外国游戏，但是卡顿和bug太多了，建议官方修一修bug，像有的时候一些道具bug，穿模bug，其次这款游戏在进行一些操作时前摇动作过长，游戏中鬼魂本来就属于会闪现的那种，让人本来就不好反应，再加上这种前摇超长情况，导致玩家很难反应，莫名其妙的突然死掉，还有就是转生系统，每100级都可以加一个转生，但是重置等级和金钱，等级重置我可以理解，作为老玩家来讲我理解用意，就是给我们这种老玩家一点新颖的体验，重回新手时期的难度，但是我不理解为什么重置金钱，我不去转生也是因为这个，毕竟我现在几百级，转生的话依旧是1转1级，也就是说不管你多少级重置以后相当于101级且没有钱没有道具，就算是做成重置等级金钱不重置也能接受，但是官方应该明白这个游戏有多难赚钱，建议官方改一下，转生以后变成一转等级减100，这种形式，让我们等级高的玩家转生不那么心疼，同时不重置金钱，可以参照等级扣出一定金钱，同时重置道具，这样感觉大部分玩家也可以接受，其次还有个别bug较为恶劣，比如有时候鬼魂猎杀时卡在墙里，和打火机明明是关闭的却有火焰还能正常使用，这种建模bug等等应该修复一下，其次就是很多鬼魂在特性上模拟其他鬼魂，甚至有点会出现自身没有的和不可能有的特性，非常影响游戏体验，导致判断正确率大大下滑，应该进行改正，还有关于摄像机和摄影机的画面显示bug，以前摄影机摄像机可以穿过门无风险拍东西，但是现在不行了，我能理解官方觉得不合理或者不平衡，修了，但是为什么有衍生出这么多的垃圾bug，现在的摄影机摄像机靠近门会黑屏，离远以后甚至有概率一直黑，无法使用，摄像机更是有时候出现镜头显示错误，出现一个大大的黑色十字，像是被胶带粘在镜头上一样，建议修改，这个会对我们造成极大的不良体验，所以各位玩家也是，想入坑也要可以接受这些bug，其次就是这个恶心人的新手指导，或者说没有一样，让你完全不知道该怎么玩，各位想玩尽量找人一起，或者随便进别的房间一起玩，游戏环境还是可以的，对新手都很友好，除了一些等级高不了多少又想装逼的，祝各位玩得开心，同时希望官方采取建议并做出相关改动，当然bug有很多，不一个一个列举了，希望我的评测会给你一点帮助

review:
Graphically it works well with mid, and upper middle settings. Never stuters while in gameplay, however many enemies it has to load.

Game wise, this game is fairly grindy, I would describe it as a mostly solo mmorpg kind of game loop. In the game you will be expected to decide your own destination, while following the basic progresion.

That is to say the game can, and should be, played as a group dungeon mmo. Only that the best descriptor of its day to day game loop is a solo mmo experiance. Grinding levels, farming for loot, gathering rare items.

This game is just a very flashy, action mmo rpg. Which is very good.

The game isnt pay to win. As a matter of fact the whole experiance can easily be played witout paying a dime. On top of this, all of the premium items and colectibles can also be bought witout spending any money. You can trade with other players for the rare items you farmed, and receive platinum (premium curency) in return.

The game is vast and i would recomend taking it slowly, but also watching a video guide if you're compleatly new. Otherwise you'll get overwhelmed and quit this very well polished game. The video guide i would recomend is IFlynn waframe ultimate beginer guide.

Other than watching video guides you can also ask for help in tutorial chat in game. There isnt a better and more welcoming community than Warframe community.

review:
Warframe is a very expansive game that serves as a good example of how to run a free game; it is fun, well made, and all purcahses are completely optional. No purchase gives you an edge over other players, and being completely free to play is not a detriment to the player. It has a good story that is constantly updated, as well as a very good development team that actually listens to player feedback.

While the game isn't perfect, and some grinds can be long, I have played more than 1000 hours on PlayStation as well as my 30-35 hours on Steam, and am still far from bored playing the game, and far from annoyed at it's creators.

review:
[h1]Warframe: The Endless Treadmill of Manufactured Boredom[/h1]

[h2]Introduction: The Illusion of Space Ninja Supremacy[/h2]
Developed by Digital Extremes, [b]Warframe[/b] is frequently praised in the free-to-play market as a shining beacon of consumer-friendly game design. On paper, it promises a hyper-stylised, high-speed power fantasy featuring cybernetic space ninjas, fluid parkour, and hundreds of unique weapons. 

However, beneath its flashy, high-fidelity exterior lies a deeply bloated, profoundly disjointed, and structurally broken experience. It is a game that values breadth over depth, masquerading artificial time-gates and an endless, multi-layered grind as meaningful content. It is less of an interactive game and more of a beautifully rendered digital spreadsheet designed to waste thousands of hours of your life. Honestly, after dealing with the constant roadblocks and forced waits, the core structure of this game feels like a total [b]piece os shit][/b].

[hr][/hr]

[h1]The Critical Breakdown[/h1]

[h2]1. The Core Loop: A Mile Wide, But an Inch Deep[/h2]
Warframe’s biggest structural flaw is its complete inability to meaningfully iterate on its core gameplay. The game has expanded rapidly over the years, but instead of refining what works, the developers continuously introduce entirely separate, half-baked islands of content that are abandoned immediately after launch.
[list]
[*] [b]The Content Island Syndrome:[/b] Mechanics like Archwing (space flight), Railjack (ship combat), and the various Open Worlds operate in completely isolated silos. The resources you spend hundreds of hours grinding in one zone are completely useless in the next, destroying any sense of cohesive progression.
[*] [b]Total Absence of Endgame:[/b] Once you have optimized your mods and weapons to deal millions of damage, you realize there is absolutely nowhere to use them. The "endgame" consists entirely of running the exact same low-level missions you did in your first hour, just with exponentially higher enemy health pools.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]2. The Progression Nightmare: Pay or Wait[/h2]
While Warframe technically allows players to earn everything without spending real money, the mechanics utilized to incentivize premium currency (Platinum) are aggressively anti-consumer and disrespectful of player time.
[list]
[*] [b]Mobile-Game Style Time Gates:[/b] When you finally spend days grinding the rare components to craft a new Warframe, you are forced to wait a literal [b]72 real-world hours[/b] for the foundry to build it. Weapons take 12 to 24 hours. This artificial stalling serves zero gameplay purpose other than to bully the player into spending premium currency to skip the wait. The mechanics in this loop are absolute [b][shit][/b].
[*] [b]The Inventory Slot Tax:[/b] You have severely limited slots for frames and weapons. If you do not pay Platinum to unlock more slots, you are forced to permanently delete weapons and characters you spent dozens of hours leveling up just to make room for new ones. 
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]3. Horrendous New Player Onboarding and Systems Bloat[/h2]
Attempting to play Warframe in the modern era without having three distinct wiki tabs open on a second monitor is an exercise in pure futility.
[list]
[*] [b]In-Game Obfuscation:[/b] The game refuses to explain its most critical systems. Modding mechanics, damage types, status procs, and Lich systems are buried behind opaque menus and horrific user interfaces. 
[*] [b]Unchecked Feature Creep:[/b] Rather than cleaning up the baseline experience, the game features a staggering amount of abandoned, bloated systems thrown at the player simultaneously with zero cohesion. It is an overwhelming mess of acronyms and currencies designed to induce burnout.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]4. Power Creep and the Death of Engagement[/h2]
Any semblance of tactical gameplay or challenge died years ago. Modern Warframe is an automated clicker game dressed up as an action title.
[list]
[*] [b]Mindless Power Creep:[/b] Due to years of unmanaged balancing, players can easily build characters that wipe out entire maps of enemies instantly through walls without ever looking at them. 
[*] [b]The Co-Op Disconnect:[/b] Playing with a squad doesn't foster cooperation; it turns the game into a visual-effects-heavy race. You will routinely load into a mission only to chase a high-level player who clears the entire map instantly, leaving you to sprint through empty hallways picking up dropped loot. It is profoundly unengaging.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Definitive Conclusion[/h2]
[b]Warframe[/b] is a masterclass in psychological manipulation and artificial longevity. It hooks players with exceptional movement mechanics and a flashy art style, only to trap them in a predatory cycle of grinding for the sake of grinding. You aren't playing to overcome challenges; you are playing to watch a progress bar tick up so you can unlock a weapon that lets you watch the next progress bar tick up slightly faster.

If you value your time and crave games with tightly designed loops, meaningful narratives, and true mechanical depth, stay far away. Warframe is a glittering, endless treadmill that will leave you completely hollow after hundreds of hours.

[b]Critical Assessment Matrix[/b]
[list]
[*] Narrative Cohesion: 4.0/10
[*] Progression Design: 2.0/10
[*] New Player Onboarding: 1.0/10
[*] Respect for Player Time: 0/10
[*] [b]Overall Definitive Rating: 3.0/10 — A Beautifully Painted Waste of Time.[/b]
[/list]

review:
Didn't play for two years, came back for the latest operation, and it's still just a genuinely good, fun game. I first picked up Warframe when I started high school over 10 years ago (yikes) and it's really only gotten better since, especially now that the devs who love the game and it's players are in charge. There is so much to enjoy, including some truly rich story telling (The Sacrifice)!

I have never paid a penny for anything in Warframe, even after 4,000 hours, but at this point I just feel bad about it! No pay to win, just cosmetics & time; you will have to wait for things to craft, and grind for the materials to make them if you don't want to pay, or you can trade items you get with other players for premium currency.

To any new players: just take it one step at a time. The sheer amount of content can be extremely overwhelming, especially for me when I come back from a long break, but if you take it one piece at a time, you'll be able to shoot & slice through it all in style!

One last thing I love about Warframe is that almost everything is viable! Naturally there is a meta, but you can make so many things work without even doing anything crazy. I don't know why so many other PvE games obsess over game balance the way they do, but it makes me appreciate a game like Warframe so much more.

review:
tl;dr: great game, but with a dev team so capricious it made me miss WoW.

Warframe is a really fun game, with incredible gunplay, movement, and an in-depth building system that proves addicting. In fact, I'll likely return and update this review if it improves! With that being said, Warframe, as it stands, is fundamentally held back by how its devs choose to handle multiple aspects of it. This includes things like:

Adding Actual Organized Group Content for the first time in years, BUT still actively refusing to add a group finder system, forcing you to use an archaic recruit chat system. Compounding this, Icebind, while incredibly fun and one of the highlights of the game right now, is partially reliant on having teammates that know basic mechanics. The baseline difficulty of the game does not prepare the average player to know what a "mechanic" is, leading to a lot of friction when combined with the group-making system that became obsolete in the late 2000s. Many things in the game reward organized and efficient group play (See: Radshares, Arbitrations, Arena nodes), but not having a large dedicated friend group means you're going to have a really bad time actually doing any of it with how fast the recruitment chat moves.

Really bad time-gating, with most forms of gearing up being locked behind weeklies (Archon Hunts, Icebind, Netracells, ETA, EDA, just to name a few). I can't blame them for this- as weeklies are the best way of getting player retention. However, the current Incarnon Genesis system is obnoxious, taking [b] NINE WEEKS [/b] to fully cycle, getting longer with each new update to the system. Combine this with how Digital Extremes often uses Incarnons as a band-aid fix for underperforming/old weapons, and each new week makes getting the Incarnon you're chasing more and more annoying? Miss a week? Too bad, have fun waiting another several months for it to come back! In addition, there's a lot of grinds in content islands that end up taking tens of hours of time-gating and grinding for... Not much apart from the very specific thing you want for your build. Warframe really doesn't respect your time, and it knows this.

Warframe as a whole has terrible QoL, especially before the "endgame." Crafting times take upwards of 3 1/2 days for a new frame, not including the grind itself. A particular gripe of mine is how cumbersome the HUD can be sometimes, with no way to tell what the tens of buff and debuffs that pop up mid-fight are apart from the very short, missable text that appears when it first triggers- and even then, you don't know what it does without looking it up afterwards. The trading system, while made palatable by a third party website, shows a troubling side of Digital Extremes that seemingly expects its playerbase to do the heavy lifting in making its incredibly archaic systems work through use of third-party websites, Discord servers, and Wikis.

Worst of all and the primary reason I've left, is Digital Extremes' utterly baffling kneejerk-heavy balancing philosophy. They have an incredibly bad history of nerfing anything that's not what they [i] want [/i] to be meta into the ground, leading to an incredibly stale buildcrafting experience that's been solved since 2019. This leads to a hostile relationship with the game's own playerbase when combined with the game's premium currency, where people who spend money on builds feel as if they've been rugpulled when they get nerfed out of nowhere. A telling example of this was quite recently, with how Icebind and its primary reward, Riven Splicing, was rolled out. A few weeks after Riven Splicing was released, one of the traits only attainable by Riven Splicing was target nerfed, with a comedically low compensation given out. This pattern of whack-a-mole style nerfs effectively deleting anything that outperforms their precious Incarnon weapons, combined with making a proper build in a manner that doesn't involve weeks of grinding often requiring real money, has slowly turned the playerbase against each other. Especially with the recent Acid Shells nerf, I've seen people turn on each other and threaten to try and get each other's playstyles nerfed to keep their own safe for a little longer. This has slowly made the community more aggressive and gatekeeping over the past few years, sometimes even harassing content creators who make videos on their builds. While harassment is obviously never justified, can you really blame players for becoming more guarded about their builds? After all, the build you spent real money on can't be nerfed if you spend [i] more [/i] money to hide your weapon names and further conceal its true identity behind a skin, right?

While I don't particularly dislike Warframe nor its developers, I can't ignore that the past year has been incredibly disappointing to play- and the game still feels like it has a complete lack of direction after over a decade, with nothing but underwhelming content island updates to show for it. I still have hope, as Icebind could be a great stepping stone to a future of actual endgame content! Unfortunately, I can't give a positive review for incomplete work that's been stringing me along for years. If you're planning on playing this, give it a bit, because it's not worth it in its current state.

Unfortunately, I can't give a positive review for incomplete work that's been stringing me along for years. If you're planning on playing this, give it a bit, because it's not worth it in its current state.

review:
Warframe is one of those games I always find myself returning to. Thanks to regular updates, patches, and new content, there's always something new to explore. Even after reaching the endgame, you can easily take a long break and jump back in whenever you feel like it. Once you've understood the core mechanics, getting back into the game is surprisingly easy.

One of the most interesting features is the variety of mission maps. Since most maps are procedurally generated, their layouts change with every run, making even familiar missions feel slightly different each time. While the core mission types can become repetitive, Digital Extremes regularly introduces new game modes and mechanics to keep things fresh.

Another major highlight is the incredible variety of Warframes, weapons, and modifications. There are countless opportunities to experiment with different builds and develop your own playstyle. Once you reach the endgame, you'll eventually realize that almost any build can become viable with the right combination of mods and equipment. This freedom is a huge part of what makes Warframe so enjoyable to me.

Overall, Warframe is an outstanding free-to-play game with an incredible amount of content and excellent replayability.

Ratings:

⭐ Graphics: 5/5
For a game released in 2013, Warframe still looks absolutely impressive. The detailed environments, visual effects, and overall design can easily compete with many modern games, in my opinion.

⭐ Complexity: 4/5
Warframe can be quite overwhelming for newcomers. Many mechanics are barely explained, and the game doesn't provide much guidance early on. Fortunately, there are now countless guides and community resources that make learning the game much easier.

⭐ Resource Usage: 5/5
Warframe is one of the best-optimized games I've ever played. Despite its impressive visuals, resource consumption is relatively low, allowing even many lower-end systems to run the game at high graphics settings.

⭐ Endgame: 3/5
Warframe doesn't really have a traditional endgame like Destiny 2 or other RPGs. Instead, it mainly revolves around farming resources, optimizing equipment, and preparing for future updates. Experimenting with different builds remains enjoyable, but the gameplay loop can eventually become somewhat repetitive. That's why my rating is a little lower here.

review:
Warframe is a fantastic game for those who look for power fantasy and grinding, and don't mind long waits and repetitive content, which is also some of it's biggest weaknesses. 

As a TLDR:
Good things:
-Interesting and unique setting, story and worldbuilding with pretty engaging characters and story beats 

-Great designs and mechanics which engage the player and encourage creativity and learning to master in higher level combat. 

-Meaningful rewards and events from every location which encourages revisiting and working with team members to collect.

-Fun alternative modes like railjack and archwing which are fully fleshed out with their own reward trees. Want to be a swashbuckling space pirate? Now you can!

-Cool weapons with massive customisation for all playstyles which allows for any playstyle from mass death to sly spy

-Great music (personal opinion)

Weaknesses:
-Extremely poor explanations of...everything. If you don't look up guides for the story, gameplay and mechanics you are screwed completely and won't have a clue what's going on. As such going into this with a friend is a must I would say.

-Main game is Repetitive. It's tough to design missions for a game of this type, but you have the options of: Kill everything, kill everything in a specific spot (with dlc of several spots), kill everything on the way to an objective, or kill everything but avoid the laser grids. If you want more out of this game, you won't find it.

-Long. Warframe is a game that feels like it pushes for constant expansion and improvement but locks the crafting for that improvement behind 1-4 days of waiting irl. You need to constantly be crafting in order to feel like you're not being inefficient, which might be a good thing for some but I personally have a gripe with it.

So that's a quick rundown, I might expand this later but this was a quick review to get it out there, hpe it helps!

review:
母牛：“小明！你的被动好碍事啊！”小明先是一愣，然后马上就理解了母牛的意思，大笑着按了一下shift，说：“哈哈！尽管来吧！”母牛同样大笑着拍上了小明的肩膀，在他之后战甲们也不再拘谨，都带着轻松的笑容，为小明送上自己的祝福。“去吧！笨蛋帽子！”“去证明你不是靠优雅吃饭的男人”“如果很辛苦就换我上吧！”“要赢啊！小明先生！”“鲨客！！”有趣的是，因为缺少双腿的关系，ash只能坐着轮椅撞向小明…
面对浑身裂隙能量喷涌而出的小明，被誉为虚空之王的墙中人，恍惚感受到了犹如排山倒海般的压力【亿万年未有的紧张感再一次浮上心头】。小明的拳头毫不留情砸向拜勒斯（20级适应mod)，致命的红色数字亮起。仓促间用杀妈刀格挡的拜勒斯身体不禁后退，墙中人猛地回头，惊疑不定的表情充分暴露在小明面前。小明利用打出红色暴击（高达三位数的红暴)时进入的【自毁境界】（100万匹力量！！！)将自身状态拉满——暴击发出的一瞬间，平常需要刻意进行的裂隙能量操作都会变得如呼吸一般自然。那是仿佛除自己外的一切都围绕着自己旋转的全能感（实则是被抽陀螺了)。小明死死钳住墙中人的手腕砸向拜勒斯，两者交叠之际，第四发暴击如期而至。拜勒斯用身体护住墙中人连退十数米，借着短暂摆脱纠缠的时机，小明开始近距离吟唱咒词。“招笑”“技能强化”“避难所”——小明就已经抬手对准了天际。墙中人惊慌失措地喊出了拜勒斯的大名，下一秒，拜勒斯像喷气发动机般追放逐而去。眼看拜勒斯已呈败势，墙中人立刻出现，将目标锁定在移速缓慢的放逐上。既然停滞的必经之路挡着小明这尊大佛，那就用【超宏大爹】将放逐无效——无论无效哪一个，只要能阻止四技能能量攒够就可以了。墙中人的身体被小明一拳打歪，可卓越者全家桶还是奔向了天际的放逐，小明望着极速飞行的超绝dot发射器翠玉激光，叹息之墙冰盾，敌方地图炮火圈，逆天伤害火柱，超绝破盾棍母电球，逆天穿盾毒。再次吟唱：“招笑”“花里胡哨”“停滞”。墙中人瞳孔放大，一股寒气扑面而来。在被压缩的时空中，墙中人明白，自己再也没有任何机会阻止灾变的诞生了

各种离奇的加载和联机bug，喜欢我大DE玩半天直接奖励你再开一局的独特玩法吗？从9重天，到钢回还有科研，九重天这都多久还能卡黑屏真的无语。
还有又臭又长的抽象剧情，要不是新甲新玩法谁特么愿意看gay佬家庭伦理剧，都开飞船了还得徒步过剧情真是没谁了；狂塞垃圾词条经常卡掉的科研，弹射器直接发射进异次元黑屏的九重天，全是构石大份的王境钢回，各种武器战甲突发奇想的削弱平衡，爆率感人的核桃，mod和配件，沟槽的不能跳过的过场动画，各种带有阴间配色和阴间分支的阴间地图，还有专治耳背眼瞎的白箱子，和阴间地图加一块更是爆炸，各种偶尔更新的离奇小bug也会让你眼前一亮。
新出6人本更是脱裤子放屁非得6个人6套甲才能进游戏是真的逆天，这么多人这么多甲是为了给泥马做开发吗？

review:
《星际战甲》差评：增幅器削弱，把坐牢体验焊死了

钢铁回廊本就是一场漫长的折磨，爆率低、任务流程繁琐、敌人强度层层堆叠，玩过的都懂什么叫“坐牢”。之前还能靠增幅器的高效输出和流畅手感稍微缓解一下这种枯燥，现在好了，直接一刀砍废，连最后一点降低时间成本的途径都没了。

1. 本就坐牢，现在更是雪上加霜：钢铁回廊的机制决定了它必须投入大量时间重复刷取，之前增幅器的147配置至少能让我在刷的过程中有点爽快感，不用全程硬扛着高压和枯燥。现在削弱之后，输出效率下降、手感变得黏糊，原本靠配装能弥补的体验缺口，现在全要靠硬肝来填。
2. 削弱的是手感，更是玩家的耐心：我不是追求极限伤害的大佬，只是想靠着增幅器让坐牢过程没那么难熬。现在好了，官方直接把这点舒适区砍掉，仿佛在说“你们就该老老实实坐牢，别想靠配装偷懒”。
3. 补偿和改动完全不对等：这点补偿连重新适应削弱后的手感都不够，更别说弥补我本来就被拉长的坐牢时间。对de来说可能只是调整数值，对我们来说，是把本来就难熬的体验又往上加了一层枷锁。

review:
So, Halo. The legendary series known far and wide that singlehandedly sold millions of Xboxes. In spite of the series eventually being handed off to 343 and put through the world's slowest suicide, the first 4 games are still universally beloved to this day. Unfortunately though, as someone who never grew up with them with no hype to cloud my vision, the series is just good and not great. You can respect something for its innovations and what it did to the industry, but the games themselves are extremely basic, poorly balanced shooters that were just vehicles to sell the multiplayer. They're not bad by any stretch, but compared to many many other shooters that came later, time has not been kind to them. These games also lose points in my eyes for prototyping things like sitting in cover doing nothing to recharge your shields in the gameplay, and snarky, arrogant and insufferable girlbosses (at least 1 per game) in the story. (But mercifully [spoiler] half of the latter do get killed off. [/spoiler] )

Halo: CE: The game that started it all. Clunky voice acting, an extremely basic story that completely shifts gears halfway through and a sombre ending that gets retconned immediately, mixed with a combat system with nothing really to offer veterans of the genre. All of the enemies are ridiculous damage sponges, to the point where it feels like every gun but the sniper, shotgun and rocket launcher shoot feathers. The level design is horrible, with hour long levels where you walk through the same 3 rooms and hallways over and over and over again followed by massive open areas with no cover, with enemy placements that feel like the devs just tossed 10 enemies into an enclosed space and called it a day. The checkpoints are extremely far apart, with a single random grenade falling off a grunt one-shotting you and costing you minutes of progress for no reason. You have a flimsy health bar that doesn't recharge like the rest of the series, and health packs are unbelievably sparce. I normally play shooters on hard mode, but I had to switch to normal to have any enjoyment whatsoever without my badass armored super-soldier dying from a stiff breeze.

Halo 2: marked improvements to the gameplay (like dual-wielding) and story, but still nothing groundbreaking. You actually find out who and what the covenant are in-game without being forced to read a book, and it's actually compelling. Playing as Arbiter for half the game is novel, but him and chief are nearly identical in every way apart from flashlight/cloak, so they feel more similar than they should. Guns still shoot feathers and the enemies are still stupidly tanky, and in the latter half of the game, nearly all of the enemies are brutes, which makes the tankiness even worse. The game also had an extremely troubled production back in the day, and as such, the game just ends on a massive cliffhanger basically out of nowhere.

Halo 3: The best game in terms of gameplay and story. Guns actually feel marginally powerful, and combat gadgets allow you to get more creative with your gameplay and positioning. The levels are well designed, combat feels good, the locales are varied, and the story comes to a pretty satisfying conclusion assuming you deem everything afterward non-canon like most fans do.

ODST: a brief spinoff that takes place between 2 and 3 starring a crack team of boring jabronies. Half the game is spent wandering through the same 3 dark, empty streets as a silent protag, maybe shooting 2 or 3 enemies before going into a flashback that plays out like a proper mission. (A very short mission, and then it's back to wandering in the dark again for the same amount of time.) It is PAINFULLY boring, and it's a story that didn't need to be told as the only thing you learn is that [spoiler] the snail-iens that you've been shooting all game are actually snail-frens. [/spoiler] That's it. Master Chief is not even mentioned once, and you only briefly hear from one of the jabroni squad again in Reach. Completely pointless.

Halo: Reach: A prequel to CE. The gameplay is "modernized" for lack of a better term, with the gimmick being armor abilities like sprinting, cloak and invincibility instead of them being powerups. The gameplay is about tied with 3 in terms of quality, and all of the characters don't get nearly enough dialogue or screentime for me to care about any of them. The game is mostly famous for its ending and how it immediately leads into the first game, but apart from that it's a pretty unncessessary prequel that still doesn't even explain why the covenent are at war with humanity in the first place. Best get reading, [I] idiot. [/I]

Halo 4: I didn't play it. I've heard that everything after 3 sucks and the story careens off a cliff, so I'm not wasting my time.

There are far worse shooters out there, and if you want to see how the genre were revolutionized back in the day, they are still enjoyable. They are still good games that paved the way for what came after, but without growing up with them, they don't even come close to my favorites of the genre.

review:
You know what's funny? Half the gaming industry is still trying to figure out how to make shooters as good as these.

Six Halo games in one collection, and the campaigns alone make this worth owning. Great stories, fantastic music, memorable missions, and gunplay that somehow still feels right after all these years.

Halo 3 is still brilliant, Reach hits differently, and the original trilogy deserves every bit of its reputation. Even the games I like less have something worth experiencing.

It's not all perfect. Some levels haven't aged particularly well, Halo 4 is a bit of a divisive one, and those bloody Jackal snipers in Halo 2 can still go fuck themselves.

But I love having all these campaigns together on PC, without needing to dig out an old console.

Funny how games from twenty years ago can remind you what you've been missing in modern shooters.

Recommended. Finish the fight. Then start another campaign.

[h1]RECOMMENDED. THANKS TO PEOPLE WHO DON'T WORK FOR MICROSOFT.[/h1]

[b]An open letter to Pierre Hintze, Vice President and Studio Head of Halo Studios (formerly 343 Industries).[/b]

Pierre,

How fucking embarrassing is Project Reclaimer for you people?

I'm genuinely curious.

People are buying Halo: The Master Chief Collection specifically to play a community-built version of Halo 3 instead of launching MCC itself.

[b]You're selling people the files they need to avoid your own product.[/b]

I've loved Halo 3 since I was eight years old. I've watched this franchise spend the better part of two decades squandering its potential while fans repeatedly explained what they wanted.

Dedicated servers. Proper server browsing. Expanded Forge. More customization. Even something as hilariously trivial as lowering your fucking weapon in multiplayer.

Apparently, we were asking too much.

Then some enthusiasts got together and started implementing this shit themselves. For free. Without Microsoft's budget. Without an entire corporate hierarchy collecting salaries to discuss the future of Halo.

And somehow, it runs beautifully.

[b]What the fuck have you people been doing?[/b]

Seriously. I'd love to hear the explanation. How does a community project manage to make Halo 3 feel more alive than the company responsible for maintaining the franchise?

You're the head of Halo Studios. Surely someone has brought this up in a meeting. Has anybody had the balls to ask why fans are getting more excited about an unofficial Halo 3 client than the official product?

Or is everyone too busy rebranding the studio again?

[hr][/hr]

[b]To anyone reading this review:[/b]

Buy MCC on Steam. Install Halo 3. Then visit [url=https://projectreclaimer.dev/]Project Reclaimer[/url].

The community has done some incredible work, and they deserve your support.

As for Halo Studios, congratulations on finally giving people a compelling reason to purchase MCC.

[b]Someone else made better use of it.[/b]

[spoiler]Please don't send Project Reclaimer a cease-and-desist. It would be nice if Microsoft could manage to leave one good thing alone.[/spoiler]

TLDR-TLDR: Humiliation Ritual: Master Cheap Collection

TLDR: The campaigns are mostly fine. Multiplayer lackluster. Entire menu system sucks majorly and is a blight compared to games from 25 years ago. The MCC is an insult to oldschool Bungie's passion, Halo 4 deserves to be KILLED in a back alley, I'm A CHUD, more news at 6

Disclaimer:
I can't really comment on the multiplayer because:
1.) I never play MP enough because even in the Halo 2 days I only ever got my ass handed to me and I'm not much of a MP person anyway. Most of my time was spent in local coop and splitscreen as well as Gearbox CE Multiplayer.
2.) The few times that I actually tried to get into a MP match on MCC, it was only after sitting in a queue for half an hour and setting the matchmaking filter to the equivalent of "just please god give me ANY lobby with more than 2 people in it"... So I stopped bothering and I haven't checked since.

The good:
So yeah that leaves me personally with just the campaigns to enjoy. And I do enjoy them, thoroughly (except 4). I appreciate that after all these years most of the bugs introduced in the Vista port of H2 and the Gearbox port of CE are finally ironed out. review:
买这个满足自己从小对光环这个IP的向往，终于可以亲自变成士官长体验这场人类史诗
战斗进化小技巧，按TAP键可以无缝切换老版本画质和新版本
接下来是游戏内容评测，包含了爽点与雷点
本质是268买了6个游戏，对于游戏时长和内容来说非常值
是非常传统的FPS游戏，非特殊武器无法开镜，只能腰射，也差不多是平移移动法，玩CS的应该适应很快
机动性在射击游戏里算高的那一档，觉得慢只是因为没有专门的疾跑而已，除了环4外没有通常意义的疾跑，致远星的疾跑是作为一个技能出现，第一次玩可能出现不适应
键位比较奇怪，数字1在两个武器间来回切，数字2切换不同手雷，4开启夜视仪或者手电筒，3没有用，zxc三个键控制着放大倍率，不过通常情况只需要右键就可以驾驭
新手建议直接简单难度，不了解武器不了解敌人的情况下即使是普通难度也可能死得很惨，玩游戏无脑爽就好
多人老是匹不到人，而且每次进入都需要登录微软账户有点烦，必须联网
比较反直觉的是，这游戏里所有的全自动武器基本没有人权，刮痧和精度低的代名词，不过在打虫族时效果很好，对策武器，而点射武器特别强，有着爆头一枪死能力
没有目标指引，很容易迷路
载具回自动往鼠标方向转弯，因此开车时a和d基本没用
老游戏，除了环4画质都不能算高，很明显的糊
在自定义界面，环4的自定义无法在战役里看见，其他都是可以的，但环4的甲最帅

review:
光环：致远星
只有玩过致远星这部才会理解到科塔娜在第一部开局动画里，当keys舰长准备留下殿后时说的："我们已经失去很多英雄了"这句话的含义。
整个贵族小队只有俊去护送哈尔西博士才活了下来……牺牲的队员里最幸福的恐怕就是乔治了，他到死都以为只要自己留下引爆炸弹，就可以守住致远星，队友们也能活下来，却不知道真正的星盟主力在那之后才到……凯特突然被狡猾的豺狼人狙击爆头死亡……卡特队长的无畏自爆牺牲……埃米尔被偷袭，用能量剑贯穿身体后的极限一换一……还有主角送走科塔娜后的英勇殿后，却只有被星盟淹没的结局……
致远星结尾是真神，它的任务名就是它的任务：活下去，它不是过场动画，而是让玩家自己体验敌人不断增多而又弹尽粮绝的那种感觉。
致远星失守了，但致远星会记得所有为他牺牲的英雄，无论是斯巴达还是陆战队，他们的死都成为了奠定人类在未来最终胜利的最坚固基石。
"斯巴达不会战死，他们只会在任务中失踪……"
祝你好运，斯巴达战士

review:
一直觉得打的流畅感还不错，在三维游戏里面都算是爽快了。后面多了很多载具和砲台，仿佛找回小时候玩《合金弹头》的快乐。坦克、疣猪号、螳螂号机器人，还有各种小摩托、双尾蛇导弹和妖姬号等异星载具，以及可拆卸的炮台，武器的越发丰富就不用多说了。很多宇宙景色也是美的经常想截图。

星盟神风烈士【提尔】、贵族小队的六位【斯巴达三期战士】以及在城市巷战的【地狱伞兵】给了整个故事越发丰富的多角度侧写。避免了斯巴达二期战士士官长【约翰】的单纯英雄叙事。

终于打完了....中间几度放弃。

我的游玩顺序 1 -> 致远星 -> 2 -> 3 -> ODST -> 4

从3开始节奏才稍微好了一点，地狱伞兵反而是我最喜欢的。

三之前真的拉完了，玩法一塌糊涂，关卡设计更是离谱。作为一个玩了这么多FPS游戏的老玩家，咱不说最高难度，上来打一个困难难度应该没什么问题，我如是想着。结果怪物硬的根本打不死，武器的精准度也让人捧腹。最普通的突击步枪，静止时的准星竟然是一个大圆...实际上很多关卡可以不打直接跑，但对于“开荒”或者说第一次玩的玩家连路线都不熟悉的情况只能把怪全清了之后找路，然而清怪又打不动，很容易子弹打光怪还没打完。推荐像怀旧的玩家全部简单难度，真没必要去死磕。又引出了另一个问题，游戏的路线指引很差，甚至某些游戏中根本就没有。

但是游戏的剧情真的是很棒，2代开始的CG也很有黄金时代的感觉。4代结尾[spoiler] 和cortana告别 [/spoiler]那段演出也不错，我的halo之旅停在这也挺好。

推荐光环前传瑞曲星和光环4，剧情感人，操控的载具也很多，每一关完成的时间不长不短恰到好处，光环4是系列里综合表现最好的。
极不推荐光环1战斗进化周年版，使用枪械无文本提示，没玩过前作根本不知道用的什么枪。战斗过程又臭又长，很多场景都是重复的，尤其第七章要在重复的场景中跑图一到两小时，然后第八章原路折返再跑一到两小时，最后一章存盘点在每场战斗前，经常辛苦打了几十分钟结果挂了只好从头再来，最后还要在时间限定内驾驶载具撤离，但那辆车又飘又难控制，翻车还会把人砸死，重复了好几次才完成。最近1代还出了重置版，看评论又翻车了，虐玩家一次还嫌不够，换个马甲再来一波。

2026.7.19
光环 致远星 英雄难度通关
+ 贵族小队塑造优秀，各个有血有肉

2026,08,10
光环 战斗进化
当我在第七关“智库”被无数波恶心的怪物和完全一致的房屋构造硬控了2个小时候，我陷入了沉思，为什么要浪费时间在这样一个无聊的游戏上？事实上这个疑问贯穿了“战斗进化”的始终，终于在这章硬来了爆发。
作为第二个被我中途放弃的游戏，我想是我配不上它，让我们放过彼此，各自安好。

review:
只推荐《光环：致远星》。

以下是原因，可能涉及剧透，所有评价仅限战役模式，无法评价多人模式因为没玩过…
光环 1：关卡后期重复拖沓，没有载具抢夺，没什么亮点
光环 2：其实光环 2 做得相当好，不管是剧情、过场还是双持武器系统，但依然有关卡重复的问题
光环 3：可能是个人原因，但尸脑兽那关真的想吐，以及，前作中的俩好朋友在这里被送走了，非常不爽
光环 3 ODST：故事设定和 2 的剧情是平行的，以 ODST 的视角讲了另一个故事，挺有趣，但是前期关卡流程上时间线切换太多，比较乱
光环 4：呵，喜欢我 343 工作室拉的吗？时间线上与 3 相隔太久，中间发生了什么需要自己场外找资料去补；关卡重复度还是老问题；武器上值得吐槽的是，先行者这么领先的科技，结果武器难用得要死？最高难度下先行者敌人很难对付，可以说完全就是灌满伤害才能打死，根本没有前面几作的趣味啊；剧情方面雷比较多，最后科塔娜走了，你猜我玩下来感觉到了啥？

review:
光环4的优化也太离谱了，前面的几作都是开最高，到4直接给显卡干崩溃了（打一会直接黑屏加强制重启后显卡出小毛病），画质调为低再限制帧数才让显卡占用降下来，能稳定游玩；本作的剧情真是一言难尽，完全没有之前作品的故事感觉，基本是二人闯所有，科塔娜与士官长的情感交流也有些变味，然后序章对斯巴达战士的起源做了说明并有一些负面评价，但又跟后续剧情完全没关联，太诡异了，更别说主线剧情的星盟突然倒戈以及先行者的实力表现很低，唯一好的地方就是补充了先行者、古人类以及洪魔的故事，填坑了halo的由来。这4代前因后果完全没交代，要自行搜索他人总结的相关官方游戏外的设定补充，这太离谱了。
  整个合集讲出的故事，感觉比质量效应的差些，没有明显的连贯性，尤其是部分情节的跳跃，整个故事并不能自圆其说，不算完整，尤其是一部分故事放在游戏外的周边上（甚至是游戏的部分新事物的发展过程放在其中，而完全没在游戏里提及），使得体验很差；游戏设计上也是纯粹的线性，不算半开放，没有构造出一个鲜活的幻想外星世界的画面，人物刻画也少，很多脸谱化甚至是酱油瓶型推动剧情的角色；大体上，体验一次不一样的射击太空旅行还是不错的，就是在沉浸感上略显单薄，但还是值得一试的。

review:
声音一直语音话筒音效，改了半天都没用。只要一联网自动开话筒根本改不了，只能断网玩。

我现在只玩了致远星，只能说真不咋地。战斗非常重复无聊，敌人和己方都有盾基本上一梭子才能打死一个小怪，遇到有盾有技能的精英怪就要打半天，重复开枪回盾再开枪回盾的循环。精英怪一多武器威力大的时候基本上就是在不停回盾，敌人打半天就是死不了，而且不得不说的一点就是这些武器射程太近了，一堆未来武器除了狙击枪几乎个个都是五十米射程，稍远一点不是没伤害就是打不中。而且明明枪半天打不死人，给的子弹还那么少，每一局都在到处找枪。

载具驾驶手感也是烂，到底是哪个天才想出的鼠标操作转向的，知道这玩意操作起来有多别扭吗？战斗机和外星人载具还好说，毕竟是可以射击和多方向移动的，人类那个越野车真难开，还不能边开车边控制机枪，结果就是开车ai打不到人，用机枪ai老是乱跑不给瞄准时机。

整个游戏重复性极高战斗不够爽玩的太累，作为一个老游戏没什么补票的必要了。

现在吧周年进化打完了。感觉上虽然周年在玩法上比致远星简陋很多，没有技能没有奔跑，但难度上要比致远星低多了。同样是困难难度，怪的盾和血条明显比致远星少，一两梭子子弹就能连盾带人一起带走。那个绿色的左手盾牌右手能量炮的怪，在致远星半天打不死，打要害要好几枪，但在周年里手枪要害一枪就死，正面也可以用手雷散弹枪直接打死。还有就是周年里越野车没血条，队友的血也很厚，一辆越野车可以打满全场。

当然缺点也有不少比如逃离那个关卡，指引太差让我迷路了好久，还有就是关卡重复都太高，跑到基地里拿数据在跑回来那段一张地图用两次很无聊。还有有些地方太难了没掩体敌人从四面八方用过来很难打，尤其是在上一个关卡子弹没剩太多或者武器不克制现在敌人的时候。

我总结的经验就是，激光枪是万能武器破盾，打洪魔都很好用，其次是散弹枪，近距离一枪破盾一枪打死，打洪魔近距离都是一枪死，其他武器都很一般。打绿盾怪最好用的是火箭炮其次是散弹枪，只要距离近怪就不会开炮用散弹枪一梭子内就能打死。还有看到载具能用就用，有一个桥上的关卡一开始停着一架飞机只要速度够快是可以强的，还有一个是敌人会开一架飞机和两辆幽灵打你，那关让队友吸引火力自己直接往存档点冲就行，不要尝试对抗。

总体来说游戏机制有些太老了，如果经常玩现代射击游戏的话可能很难适应，不太建议游玩，后面几部我也不太想玩了。

review:
What an absolutely magnificent pile of garbage.

Brawlhalla is genuinely one of the worst gaming experiences ever conceived by mankind. Imagine Super Smash Bros, remove all the fun, inject concentrated rage directly into the gameplay and give every player a crippling superiority complex. Congratulations, you've invented Brawlhalla.

The game has approximately 700 weapons, yet somehow every single opponent manages to use the most annoying one imaginable. Scythe mains are unemployed anime protagonists, Lance mains have never experienced human interaction, and Mordex players need their hard drives investigated.

The matchmaking is absolutely phenomenal. Nothing quite compares to being matched against someone with 4,000 hours, a diamond border and the reaction speed of a fucking cheetah when you're just trying to enjoy a casual game.

And the taunting. OH, THE TAUNTING. Apparently winning a 1v1 against someone with half your playtime is a monumental achievement worthy of a presidential medal.

The ranked system is less of a competitive environment and more of a government-approved torture facility. You gain 20 Elo, lose 25, and suddenly your entire afternoon has been wasted.

Pros:

    Free to play (unfortunately).

    Has some decent character designs (petra a baddie).

    Occasionally enjoyable when nobody is playing.

Cons:

    Everything else.

    Scythe players.

    Lance players.

    Mordex players.

    The matchmaking.

    The community.

    The fact that I keep reinstalling it.

Final verdict: 0/10.

Would not recommend to my worst enemy. Actually, I would. They deserve it

review:
I have a pure, burning hatred for Brawlhalla—and somehow, I love it more than ever.

This game has a special talent for turning one match into a full emotional journey. One second, I’m landing a perfect combo and feeling unstoppable; the next, I’m flying off the stage because I missed one attack by a pixel. Every loss feels personal, every opponent suddenly looks like a professional, and every time I say, “Okay, last match,” I somehow end up playing five more.

But that’s the magic of it. Brawlhalla is fast, chaotic, and ridiculously satisfying when everything clicks. Pulling off a clean read or making an impossible comeback feels amazing—and just when I’ve decided the game is the worst thing ever made, it gives me one of those moments that reminds me why I keep coming back.

So yes, I hate Brawlhalla. I hate how frustrating it can be, how it makes me blame the game instead of my own decisions, and how it keeps tempting me into “one more match.” But I love the competition, the chaos, and the feeling of finally getting it right.

In short: Brawlhalla is the game I love to hate—and the game I hate to stop loving. 

If you want to jump off a cliff but have a good time doing so then play this game.

刚开始玩还行，到后面就会越打越红温，越打越烦。
就不说游戏本身的服务器问题和匹配机制还有各种的系统问题。

这个Brawlhalla本来一个非常好的格斗游戏，就是与各类格斗游戏一样是来体验不同角色带来的各种不同攻击形式以及不同的连击配合带来的快乐，但是这个游戏的机制并不是很鼓励你去体会和研究各种不同攻击形式以及不同连击，而是会让你变成只会重击放技能恶心对手折磨对手的状态。
因为游戏里存在着不同角色的重击技能都有不同形态的攻击状态和统一轻击的攻击状态，而且重击技能不会有任何代价，不费蓝不费时间而且伤害高范围大。
然而就是因为技能收益高大于低收益的存在，让这个游戏出现了只会盲目重击的游戏群体，而这群只会放技能的群体让这个格斗游戏变质了，变成了不再挖掘各种攻击连招和玩法，只会重击放技能的老赖。
我玩了五六年了，从没做过改变。有些人喜欢这个游戏就会去专研轻击配合重击带来的连招快乐，但是永远比不上只会重击的人群来得简单粗暴。你不停的攻击他很多下，不如对面放重击击中两三次就结束了，如果都鼓励大家用重击打人的话，轻击不如删了，连招教学也别放了。           强烈建议给重击附加一些条件

这行为就像盲人园丁一样，精确地挥舞那把荒谬的镰刀，把整片麦田变得无比杂乱。

review:
游戏本身是相当不错的，很推荐给想要入坑这个游戏的新人朋友，当然这个游戏也有十分劝退的地方。
我主要活跃在移动与ns平台，并非steam。总游戏时长超700小时。

  1.如果你只是把brawlhalla当作休闲大乱斗游戏（本质也是平台格斗），你可以玩得很开心（如果你有愿意和你一起玩的朋友）。但如果要体验它纯粹的格斗部分（特别是1v1模式），你将会被恶臭的环境（包括但不限于：嘲讽，被动，粪招复读）与惊人的elo机制恶心。
  2.此游戏的服务器是土豆做的。大多数时候甚至挂加速器都无法稳定连上东南亚或日本服务器（这是距离中国最近的两个服务器）。
  3.bmg在越来越多次的更新中，将游戏的平衡性做的很烂（主要是在1v1模式中），很多角色的攻击过于变态。
  4.这款游戏的时间与学习成本是非常巨大的，上百小时才刚入门（这里同样指格斗技术方面的）
  5.游戏对新手非常不友好。

总之，如果你只是想与朋友们（如果有的话）一起玩玩休闲大乱斗，你可以很快地在brawlhalla中寻找到快乐。但如果你想在格斗技术方面有所发展，你要做好吃苦与被恶心的准备。

It's not a map game, it's a ride around on a horse and slice people game. And boy does it excel at the horse and slicing elements. The field battles are wonderful, the armor is really cool, the arena fights are challenging, all in all, it's just a great adventure. 

I would pick this one up.

review:
No. 
It's been so many years, and this game is still far from finished. And even further from becoming even slightly as fun as the PoP was. Or Persino. Or some other mod for Warband. 
My main gripe is that this game has no challenge in it, like at all. You can try to gimp yourself and make up some dumb masochistic rules, but I really shouldn't be doing that in any game. PoP had giant invasive armies, some of them could even form their own kingdoms by capturing a bunch of settlements. There was always a reason to either be a vassal and strengthen your kingdom, or to make your own. Or you could just take on those armies all by yourself, just to have some fun in beating them alone. 
And what does this game have? Dumb-ass AI that is incapable of... literally anything? Even RBM can't help this game, seriously. 

And some more about the AI; MY GOD it is DUMB. I'm not even sure if you can call it "AI", because they lack any sort of intelligence. On the battlefield, they just build a few formations, and then either press F3, or F1. That's it. And the formations aren't even any different from lord to lord, only different kingdoms have roughly different formations.
Oh, and kingdoms? Absolute clown fiesta. Sometimes lords and even whole armies are just going for a ride in the middle of the enemy territory, and dying like a bunch of lemmings. And sometimes, they just do nothing. 
You will, quite literally, have a single kingdom cornered by 2 or 3 different wars, and they will just sit and do NOTHING. Their opponents may even be in an alliance, and yet, they'll just AFK in their towns, waiting for the harvesting season. 

The economy in this game is in even worse state. Like, you just do an early-game money making method, and then you fight a bunch, and now you have an infinite flow of money. Woah. 

Your PC is also completely unimportant, unlike how it was in PoP. You might as well remove your character from the game, HELL, you CAN JUST GO AND BECOME A HERMIT, AND MAKE YOUR LVL30 TERMINATOR WIFE A KING.
Like, what is the point of your existence even? Especially on the battlefield. 

And quests? They've added stealth mechanics and shit,, but WHY? You don't need those quests. They don't give you ANYTHING of worth. ABSOLUTELY NOTHING. Releplay purposes? Well, I can go and replay KCD1/2 if I want some medieval roleplay. 

And this is not like they are improving the game. It's getting WORSE, not better. Man, you probably don't even want to buy their DLC, just because it feels more like a very underbaked and unnecessary mod rather than an official DLC. Also, DLC in an early access game. Classic. 

TL:DR - Just play PoP for Warband, not this pointlessly grindy (and just generally pointless) piece of early access. 
Maybe sometime later down the line, taleworlds finally will open their eyes and do to this game whatever IndieStone have done to PZ. Maybe...

review:
Had the review thumbnail appear in my profile for absolutely ages now and always put it off because I don't really know what to say to adequately describe truly how good this masterpiece is. I've not played it in a few weeks now so I have the benefit of not wanting to play it again (temporarily), because I'd normally just click the play button.
Ironically, by not actually  playing the game for a few weeks it has made me appreciate even more how spectacular this game really iss.

To all people that have never played any Mount and Blade game before:

It's really quite tricky to describe the sort of game this is because it really is it's own genre in a way (or should be).
I'll try my best, so here it goes -
It is a fully sandbox fantasy medieval RPG (and I mean FULLY - the campaign mode is basically the same as the sandbox mode but it essentially just gives you tutorials and starting family members, which are really useful to have in your first play through). 
If you like big budget story driven top graphic RPG's, this definitely is not for you. It is none of those things.
It has literally no story line - because YOU make the story.
It isn't big budget - it's taleworlds.
It's got fantastic battle graphics despite it's low budget, but it's not on the scale of all the big boys.

What really makes this game is the literally infinite possibilities.
You can literally do anything.

Everybody starts off with a set of clothes and a horse. (If you do campaign mode you also start off with a brother and sisters, which help massively building your clan).
The rest is up to you.
If you want to become a bandit - and build a group of bandits that raid and pillage towns/villages - you can.
If you want to be a trader, mind your own business, not hurt anybody, and just trade goods / buy and run your own workshops - you can.
If you want to become a leader of your own band of warriors and get factions to pay you as a mercenary to fight for them - you can.
If you want to be a great fighter and just wander from town to town fighting in arenas to gain renown - you can.
If you want to prove yourself in battle and join a faction as a vassal, to fight for your king/liege and prove your worth and get rich - you can.
If you'd rather create your own faction and gain your own lands , and eventually rule the whole world - you can.
It has absolutely everything.
If you'd rather not war or trade, but want to spend your time in the smithy, breaking down raw materials and/or crafting weapons for a profit or for favour with NPC's - you can!
In any of these potential avenues, you can marry and have children - or not. It's completely up to you.
The game environment is different every time you play it. The  world economy runs as its own unique economy each playthrough. What might work one playthrough, might not  necessarily work in another..Or it might?.

Having said everything I have said, the game DOES revolve mostly around fighting. You WILL need to be somewhat competent as a fighter (although I know of people who have done completely pacifist saves without fighting at all as traders - but it is  difficult).
With this in mind, the battle/combat system is basically like playing a Total War game (any of them), except you are issuing instructions to your troops whilst being physically present as a character on the battlefield.
Want to focus more on the strategy, rather than fight? You can.
Want to  dart about on your horse (or dismount and go on foot?) with a massive axe or crossbow ((or  normal bow, 2h sword, or  1h + shield, or mace (1h or 2h), or polearm or bare knuckles)),  smashing people in battle and leave the strategy to your sergeants? You can.
Want to do a bit of both? You can.
Then comes the absolute best bit of the battles which i didn't even mention yet - sieges.
Build trebuchets, onagers, balistas, siege towers, battering rams. Operate them yourself in the siege. Climb up the ladders yourself. Command which units go up ladders, which go in towers, which go where. On the battlefield like total war, except you're actually fighting it like in an RPG.
Defending against a siege? You can do the same. You can even pick up the siege ammunition without a siege weapon and throw them through the castle/settlement walls at the enemy!
You can auto resolve all battles as well like in TW, if you don't want to fight a particular battle or siege.

There's honestly 100 other things I can't cram in to this right now, but the main thing is there are some absolutely unbelievable mods that have been designed by the community that expand and improve QoL, but also mods that change the game entirely. All for free.

review:
Held off on posting a comment for a long time, but I cannot anymore. It's been 4 YEARS people, and this still feels like early access to me. As a warband veteran going to as far back as original MnB release, I have to say - don't buy it yet. If ever. I don't understand where these positive comments come from, but I believe people are just looking at it through rose-tinted glasses. This game as vanilla is boring and repetetive sometimes, but thats not the main problem with it. It relies on modding community to add to its value, but with every new release most mods get broken, and I understand why frustrated modders of some quintessential mods have just quit out of frustration. NOW, 4 years after slapping the 1.0 label on an unfinished product, breaking some of the best minor and overhaul mods along the way, you are asking me to again PAY YOU for something that anybody who has played VC has been asking for forever - ships! FFS even mods did that and in a good way way before War Sails (see Shokuho). Without mods, the game is unfinished, with mods it's unstable.

But the last straw is the fact that even in pure vanilla form the game STILL crashes from time to time, and not on worst hardware (I5 12400F + RTX 5050 8GB + 16 GB DDR5 is NOT an ancient setup). MAYBE I will come back to this and change the review if I see some improvements AFTER the development cycle is over, but seriously, charging people for ships and one faction like for full game is too much. I'll stick to warband.

review:
Honestly, Bannerlord feels almost exactly like Mount & Blade: Warband, just with better graphics and a more modern presentation. The core gameplay, combat, and overall gameplay loop feel remarkably similar, and after playing it, I struggle to understand what makes this worth such a high price. I expected a sequel to bring more meaningful improvements and a genuinely different experience, but instead, it feels like I’m paying a premium to play essentially the same game I played years ago. The combat doesn’t feel particularly revolutionary, and much of the gameplay feels like a repeat of Warband with a fresh coat of paint.
I understand that there are improvements to graphics, battles, and certain systems, but personally, they aren’t enough to justify the price. For a game this expensive, I expected more substantial changes to the core experience.

If you already own Warband, I’d have a hard time recommending Bannerlord at full price unless you’re specifically looking for better graphics and larger-scale battles. For me, the overall experience just doesn’t feel different enough to justify the cost.

review:
TLDR: I would have loved to see extra time and care put into this game, as I feel the core gameplay loop is great.

I feel devastated when I play this game because of the wasted potential that I am reminded of. The core loop of building  your army, sieging enemy fortresses and fighting battle after battle is incredibly addicting. However, I feel like the game is missing the more in depth aspects that would make it a masterpiece and a genre defining title. Certain parts of the game lack depth and can be frustrating to engage with. Diplomacy, dialogue, familial systems, companion systems, and battlefield strategy feel like aspects of the game that weren't given enough love by the devs, which is frustrating because in the late game they are tend to be important systems that need can't be ignored. 

I have to commend the devs on building a world that doesn't make you the main character. I absolutely love the feeling that everyone has independent motivations, and seeing all the armies and caravans go about their business is great. However, it's an illusion that quickly falls away once you gain more power in your playthrough. Ultimately the goal of becoming the ruler of the lands makes for a fun, engaging game with a strong core loop. I just feel sad when I think about how much more interesting the game could be if it had more depth.

review:
Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is a good game overall and one of the most interesting medieval sandbox games available. Building your clan, creating your own kingdom, commanding armies, and fighting massive battles can keep you entertained for hundreds of hours. The game offers a level of freedom that very few strategy RPGs can match.

My biggest issue with the game is the lack of a co-op campaign. Bannerlord feels like the perfect game to play with friends. Imagine leading different clans in the same world, fighting together in battles, managing kingdoms, or conquering Calradia as a team. It is disappointing that this feature was never added, and I honestly believe it is the game's biggest weakness. I hope that if Bannerlord 3 ever gets made, TaleWorlds finally adds a proper co-op mode.

Another major problem is smithing. The system is extremely unbalanced. You can start with around 5,000 coins and, after only 2-3 hours of smithing, end up with several million. This makes trading, workshops, caravans, and many other money-making methods feel almost pointless.

The problem is that you cannot simply ignore smithing either. While you can choose not to use it for making money, you will miss out on some of the best weapons in the game. Crafted weapons can easily outperform most equipment you can find or buy, making smithing feel almost mandatory if you want the strongest gear.

I also think the crafting system could be expanded. It would be great if we could craft armor, not stronger or unique armor, but simply the armor pieces that already exist in the game. Sometimes finding a specific armor set is a complete headache because of how random shops and loot can be. Being able to craft existing armor for yourself and your troops would be a great quality-of-life feature without hurting game balance.

Another feature I would love to see is the ability to create custom troop trees. Instead of relying entirely on existing faction troops, players could design and equip their own units. Creating a unique army that reflects your kingdom's culture and fighting style would make the late game much more enjoyable and add another layer of customization.

Combat is generally good, but some mechanics feel questionable. Crossbows not being able to penetrate shields feels strange. It is also a bit silly when a fully maxed-out warrior with a two-handed sword or axe gets his attack blocked by an enemy carrying a tiny wooden hammer. These moments can break immersion and make combat feel less believable than it should.

The AI is decent, but nothing special. It is not terrible, but it is far from great. Sometimes kingdoms gather huge armies only to run around the map without accomplishing much. Instead of capturing settlements or defending their territory, they often wander around seemingly without a clear objective.

One mechanic that I actually like is that axes and some polearms can cleave through multiple enemies in a single swing. It makes weapon choice more meaningful and gives those weapons a unique advantage. At the same time, it is disappointing that most other weapons cannot do the same. A massive two-handed greatsword should not stop after hitting a single enemy while an axe can cut through several soldiers. I think more weapon types should have access to this mechanic, especially larger two-handed weapons.

Another thing that stands out is how much the game relies on its modding community. Sometimes it feels like Bannerlord is still alive because of modders constantly adding new content, fixing issues, and expanding gameplay. It is great that the community is so passionate and talented, and many mods genuinely improve the game. However, I think the developers should be doing more themselves instead of relying on the community to solve many of the game's shortcomings.

A good example is the Diplomacy mod. Features from that mod should already be part of the base game. Managing a kingdom can become frustrating because you often have to chase NPCs all over the map just to talk to them. For example, recruiting a clan to your kingdom can turn into a long game of hide-and-seek. Diplomatic actions should be easier to handle, and some form of messaging system, diplomacy menu, or improved kingdom management would make the experience much smoother.

As for multiplayer, it is mostly for a specific audience. Some players enjoy it a lot, while others will spend almost all their time in single-player. It is not bad, but it feels less popular and less interesting than the campaign experience.

Overall, Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is a very good game with excellent large-scale battles, a unique sandbox experience, and plenty of replayability. Despite issues such as unbalanced smithing, average AI, basic diplomacy, and some questionable combat mechanics, the game remains one of the best medieval war simulators available today. However, the missing co-op campaign is what prevents it from reaching its full potential for me.

I hope TaleWorlds learns from Bannerlord's strengths and weaknesses and makes Bannerlord 3 a much better game. If they add co-op, improve diplomacy, balance smithing, introduce custom troop creation, armor crafting, smarter AI, and larger battles, I genuinely believe it could dominate the medieval sandbox genre for a very long time.

I'm also looking forward to Chronicles: Medieval, which is currently planned for release in 2027. Competition is always good because it pushes developers to improve their games. I think Chronicles: Medieval has the potential to be a strong competitor to Bannerlord 2. However, if TaleWorlds addresses the major issues mentioned above in a future Bannerlord 3, I believe it would be on another level entirely and could remain the dominant medieval warfare sandbox game for years.

There is a Mod that seems like it would fit into Bannerlord perfectly, I beg of you, make the "DynaCulture" mod a vanilla Sandbox modifier, Please. A quick rundown on what it does, if a faction holds a fief for long enough, that fief will start changing cultures, there's a lot of options for it, but even a basic version would be loved. A note that I really like, the culture change is NOT instant, recruits from villages will be half and half, I also pair it with the "Change a Vassals Culture" and "Change a Companions Culture". Seeing this introduced would be one of the coolest things ever, and with the recent additions to the sandbox mode, it seems more possible than ever. Imagine being in the Nordic faction, and sailing all the way around the world to conquer the Aserai, just to make a "Southern Nordic Enclave. This could really introduce new goals for the game, not to conquer, but to make a kingdom of enclaves all over and try to protect them. Watching kingdoms change borders, and having their culture follow could be the coolest thing ever, not to mention it would make it easier for players to create custom maps.
I LOVE the game, and don't want to have this come up as useless criticism, but I truly beg of you to let vanilla-only player experience that side of bannerlord.

review:
I have a hard time describing this game. There is so much love devoted to every inch of it.
if you just mash through the menus, and watch the numbers go up, its great. but if you really pay attention and slow down a little, this game is absolutely incredible. every detail of every map makes me feel like i'm inside a beautiful continent, and experiencing the combat is rich and engaging, both in the original format; land battles, and sea battles as well. theres such a huge difference between being tactician and getting involved int he battle and you choose that every time, whether you want to send troops and simulate the battle, or simulate the battle, coordinate your troops and just sit there, or let them watch you handle the entire army on your own.

I loved:
The immersive gameplay, getting to walk through town, interact and involve yourself in sieges and battles and make a difference. The complexity is rewarding, you can achieve so much in this game, and each choice gives a different gameplay style. Beautiful sets, beautiful graphics. 

What i noticed:
It was a bit heavy on my computer, which is understandable it is not a gaming pc. 
There are some pretty noticable graphical glitches that i cannot seem to isolate, but when they aren't happening, everything is spectacular. mods and community development is great as the community is very involved in making this game as expansive as the developers originally intended.

What i didn't like:
Some of the quests and missions were a bit repetitive in my opinion. certain actions would clog up the notifcation screen and this would often get in the way of gameplay. gameplay loop is very fun, but some small part of me wants to see more creative aspects of the game being exercised: for example i was very disappointed that i couldn't "walk about the ship" if i was paused at sea, with the warsails mod. (i am not entirely sure if warsails is made by taleworlds as well, if it is not, please disregard.) I wish we could have more control over villages, like production, mayors, or something to feel like you really are a providing landlord, but i am not appropriately versed in economics and game theory to explain how. in my opinion the only way it could be better is if it was more cosmopolitical drama to make us more acquainted with characters because i feel like sometimes i just hear the same dialogue again and again, and i would love to see some social settings fleshed out. oh, and sometimes, there are some gamebreaking math bugs in th the autobattle feature, where one man defends against full armies, and it has happened a few times, and it was really hilarious, but a little demoralizing.

this is one of the best games i've ever played with the most well rounded gameplay and the best combat, economics and overall gameplay i've experienced since i was 10, playing kessen, and pikmin and wishing i could do both at the same time.

9.9/10

review:
A Triumphant Simulator of Skeletal Fortitude and Tactical Fluidity
Verily, I say unto you, Calradia is a realm historically beset by the heretical dry-cereal mindset. For years, factions have squabbled over butter and grain while ignoring the true foundation of empire: uncompromised skeletal density.

Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord is the definitive digital holy land for those who understand that battles are not won by steel alone, but by the weight of your bones when charging a couched lance at full speed into a fragile Khuzait archer.

Why the Lactose Dominion Approves:
Superior Bone Density Mechanics (10/10): When a Vlandian knight crashes into your shield wall, the collision physics accurately simulate what happens when a body fortified by whole milk meets an opponent whose joints have been ravaged by almond water. You can literally hear the cartilage of the Oat Resistance breaking upon impact.

Economic Diplomacy (10/10): The trade systems allow you to establish a complete monopoly over cows, butter, and livestock across every village from Sargot to Razih. I have personally brought entire enemy kingdoms to their knees not through siege engines, but by embargoing dairy until their garrison’s teeth turned to chalk.

Melee Combat & Weight (10/10): The directional blocking and heavy swing physics reward true strength. Swing a two-handed executioner's axe and watch the unfortified heathens collapse into breadcrumbs before you.

  前期升级方法单一，后期纯涂色游戏，当封臣要面对沙雕国王的沙雕政令，什么叫我打到对面老家了你要和谈，还组成军团到处浪；当国王要面对吊毛封臣抢功，什么叫打下来的城不能给自己，全是几个神人把地分完了不给我，还要到处宣战，生怕老子舒服一点；花大钱娶的对象是个会生孩子的伙伴定位，对象能干的事在街边酒店随便招的人也能干，你有什么用啊？前期结婚真的很烧钱欸。性格系统就是滚木，完全上不了台面；外交系统拉跨，除了宣战，交易，结盟就没了；城市建设系统也拉跨，不同文化地真的容易叛乱；升级系统更是拉完了，超过35级往上真的升不动了，天下都统一了，还在这里卡级。

  每次更新bug一堆，老bug也不修，然后模组暴雷，还要一个一个重新排查。dlc半成品都拿那出来卖，玩原版都能卡死机。

  傻逼烤肉社，我要那你的头盖骨当酒杯使。

简短版（直接复制Steam）
 
推荐！独一无二的中世纪冷兵器沙盒。亲手带兵冲锋、骑枪冲刺的快感别的游戏很难替代。可以跑商、招兵、攒军团、攻城建国，玩法自由度拉满。
缺点：外交AI很迷惑，后期玩法重复，原版任务比较单调。
重点：创意工坊mod才是本体！ 打mod之后体验直接质变，喜欢中世纪带兵打仗的闭眼入。
 
✅完整版
 
推荐✅《骑马与砍杀2：霸主》
时隔多年的续作，保留了骑砍系列灵魂：方向格挡冷兵器战斗、大地图自由沙盒，从一个小人物慢慢起家，跑商赚钱、招募士兵、培养同伴、攻城略地，最后自立为王，每一局的故事都不一样。
千人战场的氛围感很强，骑兵冲锋、步兵结阵、仰攻城墙，亲自下场厮杀的代入感一绝。锻造系统、家族声望、城邦管理，比战团的系统丰富很多。
 
但是原版短板也很明显：
AI领主操作很迷，外交系统一言难尽，说开战就开战；大地图追人折磨，后期统一路上重复度很高，任务大多是跑腿；部分BUG、城池管理繁琐。
不过它有最强的救星——创意工坊！各种三国、奇幻、战争mod直接换一个游戏，可玩性翻几倍。
 
适合人群：喜欢中世纪、冷兵器、带兵打仗、沙盒自由玩法的玩家。
不适合：想要强主线剧情、精致剧情演出的玩家。
 
✅玩梗短句版
 
骑砍2，原版是半成品，mod才是完整版！
一枪冲刺，千军万马，从流民到国王，这爽感独一份。就是追领主追到崩溃，外交全靠随缘😂
 
你想要哪个版本？要不要我再写一个差评风格的？

review:
如果只用一个词的话，我想用幻象来形容我在骑砍中的这几十个小时的体验。
在骑马与砍杀中，我从一个名不见经传的小角色开始，在村庄城镇招募几个士兵，扫荡劫匪，参加竞技大赛，解救哥哥和弟弟妹妹，一步一步提升家族的威望，扩大自己的军队规模，辗转各个国家作为雇佣兵而战，打出名气后成为某个国家的封臣，时机成熟时自立为王，招募家族，攻城掠地，最终一步一步称霸整个大陆。
看起来是一个很惊险刺激的游戏对吧，确实，在我的可能前50个小时的游戏体验中，骑砍已经完全占据了我的生活，以至于吃饭时，睡觉前，都在期待着下一次的游玩。那么但是，为什么要用幻象来形容我的游戏体验呢。我认为一个游戏最好玩的时候，是你沉浸到忘记这是一款游戏的时候。但是骑砍的很多细节之处，时时刻刻都在提醒你，这只是一款游戏。例如成为国王后，你亲自招募的家族中居然有不认识自己的成员，于敌军之中解救出来第一句话居然是“陌生人……”，我不想过多的去回忆游戏体验过程中让我出戏的部分，但这些真实存在的瑕疵之处十分影响我个人的代入感。
落到具体的游戏玩法上，例如潜行、城镇帮派等，如果不是在攻略中看到，我都不知道它们的存在，并且其实际对游戏整体的影响微乎其微，基本带不来多少收益且无趣。还有一些例如经商和内政玩法，过于臃肿且自由度极低。很多强制设定既无法增强沉浸感，也不够便捷，白白浪费游玩的时间。
说了这么些缺点，不可否认的是，看着自己军队逐渐壮大的满足感，攻打下一座座城池的成就感，还有自己驰骋沙场如天神下凡碾碎敌军的刺激感，都让我无法昧着真心打出低分，所以还是给出五颗星。
在这段游戏体验的同时，从社区获取的点滴信息都反应着开发商对游戏更新维护的懈怠，最近一次1.5的大更新似乎就已经占了所有更新的大部分了。不过在玩法这么有趣的底子之上，除了期待后续更完美的版本也别无他法。

review:
我玩骑砍已经1000小时了，我曾经非常热爱这款游戏，我喜欢跑商、喜欢打仗、喜欢砍杀、喜欢下Mod、喜欢培养家族与同伴。

这是一款陪伴了我几乎整个大学时光的游戏，但是在今天我还是要给出差评。

我的差评针对无所作为、混吃等死、摆烂懒惰的烤肉社。你们曾经是一个伟大的工作室，从一对土耳其夫妇开始，创造了骑砍这样一个至今在中世纪大战场领域内没有竞品的游戏，满足了很多人骑马与砍杀的梦想；但是你们现在不配有任何的赞誉。

粗制滥造的DLC、多年不改善的陈旧外交与内政系统、单调乏味永远一模一样的卡拉迪亚大陆、从来不改善的底层代码，你们每天的工作就是躺在曾经的成功上悠闲地混吃等死，时不时动动手指改改表单中的几个数据，然后就堂而皇之地拿出来糊弄玩家，这就是你们烤肉社这个蔑称的由来

我曾花费数十个小时，寻找、下载、调试各类Mod，忍受百度网盘那半死不活的限速，权游、战锤、欧陆、流浪星星，每一个Mod都陪伴了我很长的时间，每一个也都曾因各种报错而困扰着我。

我曾花费数百个小时，假借你们这简陋的内政外交，幻想自己是卡拉迪亚的一位人物，我要如何地生活、战争、经营，我要如何走完我的中世纪一生，扮演行商，我从需要宰猪杀牛关注各种价格变化的小商贩，渐渐变成了坐拥两三百人、财富百万、囤积大量物资，轻而易举就能影响一座城市甚至一个国家物价的超级商人；扮演佣兵，我从那个打海寇都要小心骗标枪的小队长，渐渐成长为拥有数百精锐老部下，以及一众精心培养的家族子弟和同伴、战力能够决定一场战争走向的超级佣兵；扮演领主，我从欢天喜地平白获封一处小城堡、每天发愁赚钱养活军队的小领主，渐渐变成了一位控制整座大陆、开创全新时代、终结世界战乱的皇帝。

我曾花费数千个小时，憧憬我的人生会是什么样子的，会像游戏里的传奇人物一样吗？我会拥有骑士？长剑？战争？冒险？鲜花？挚爱？战友？传说？我这样的人有朝一日可不可能像小说里那样，穿越到异世界，开始一段独属于我的传奇旅程呢？我会拥有红颜知己吗？我会拥有超凡天赋吗？我会成为一位名扬天下的大人物吗？

现在我醒了，我的大学生活结束了，我意识到那些会出现在小说人物里的穿越、系统、运气一样都没有出现在我身上，我只是我，一个马上就要面临就业与生活压力的我；我没有青梅竹马、没有随身系统、没有过人的天资、没有超群的智慧，我只是我，一个夜里常常为自己哭泣的我。

我没有你们这样肆意躺平的资本，我不敢也不能混日子，我的家庭还算美满，但也只是普通的小康，我们会为一顿火锅而期待，也会为一次七八十的自助而开心；我们会为一件几百块的衣服而心疼，也会为一张上千的机票而犹豫。我们只是普通人，不敢有太多奢望、不敢有太多放肆、不敢追求所谓自由的普通人。

但我想，我也不止是我，在中国，还有千千万万的人是像我这样的，我们不是这个时代的主角，也不是潮头之上的弄潮儿，我们没有可以傲慢和放纵的出身，也没人受人追捧和热爱的外貌，我们听说过许多美好，在互联网上见惯了昂贵的美食和奢靡的生活，我们曾经会幻想自己出人头地成为其中一员，每天只需要稍稍工作，就能轻易赚取足够享受的金钱。

但是我不得不知道，现实不是这样的，多数人的人生不是这样的，我们只能面对未知，我们没有兜底，我们注定庸碌。

人人生而不平等，世界生而不和谐。

不是每一个梦想都能实现，不是每一颗星星都能闪闪发光。

在过去与未来的深夜里，我依旧会为自己哭泣，也为我们哭泣。

再见了，骑砍，永别了，烤肉社。

review:
Honestly, I didn't expect much at first as a game which from screenshots I've seen being mostly dialogue. This is my first JRPG and I can say that P5R really shows how far you can really push an RPG. 
I'm about 25% done with the game with 30 hours and I can say for myself its amazing.

Now for why it is amazing, the music... its beautiful, the GUI and UI are so stylish and unique it just feels cool even scrolling around settings and menus. 
It is a turn-based combat game which I usually don't really like but P5R adds so much life to it that make the turn-based combat less repetitive (it can get repetitive).
The story is excellent, the characters are written well and likable etc... 

However, I find that sometimes palaces can get tedious and annoying (skill issue on my part).
Sometimes dialogue can get frustratingly long and annoying (this is not a usual case) and with turn-based combat which can again become repetitive. 

Overall, 8/10 for recommending to others as some people may not be built to play P5R and experience true level of peak.

review:
117小时全成就。
先说缺点：战斗上来说不是一个很有意思的玩法系统，战斗中的演出也并不好看。宫殿的地图虽然设计得不错，但是视觉上以及玩起来都有点无聊。印象空间纯纯负分，要不是有龙司的coop技能，这个真能无聊到把人劝退，而且那个印章，跑一遍居然收集不全，要反复跑，并且随机刷新，太蠢了。
但是这确实本质上是一种galgame啊，日常做得太棒了，真的是角色扮演的感觉。白天的课程、放学后的冒险、晚上的约会，时不时的考试、外出旅游，以及暑假，各种店家和日常事件，加上“台面下”的黑暗涌动，换上怪盗的身份拯救世界，游戏从一开始就以绝对的情绪推动力和代入感将玩家拉入这个世界。虽然有些剧情有点太宅了，有的多少有些诟病，但是日常、coop、以及大部分主线都挺好的。主角实实在在地与各位配角们生活了一年，确实也建立起了感情羁绊，每一个人都很有趣，每一个人到了最后都不想分开（除了明智）。
在原版基础上新增的皇家版内容的话，反派塑造很好，但是动画和演出质量下降很多，学妹的路人感也十分幽默。

review:
一场断断续续 为期四个月的旅程小记

坦白来说 Persona 5 并不是我心目中那个完美的折叠平成年代年轻人都市日常的作品。多处令人大跌眼镜却又难以细细推敲的关键转折让这样一个中二少年拯救世界的热血侠盗剧情只能当得起一个mediocre；味同嚼蜡的回合制战斗更是冲淡了许多作品正线中真正闪光的部分 让我算尽心机 总想着动用一些特殊手段（感谢大神）给shadows上上强度。

但放下游戏 即使我的理性可以为这段不完美的旅途找到无数的接口 感性总还剩下一种淡淡的惆怅。我所无法释怀的 依然是这样我永远无法再实现的 能够支配自己的时间 挥洒自己的青春 在为自己中二实体化的梦想努力的同时交到知心的朋友 享受一种不存在的中产文化图景式的高中生活的幻梦 以及这样美好的黄金岁月所必然结束的不舍。

文本中逐步攀登的罪恶的本质并非“大人丑恶的欲望” 无论个人想被何等满足 最终的裁决也不过是由社会道德与法律所制定的相对公义罢了。当所有看似在作恶的独立个体都被“改心”之后 主角们才发现自己所面对的不仅仅是一个个具体的 可被审判的恶 而是所有扭曲者的共通之处：当权力用标签 身份 成功学 道德标杆去定义个体 个体就不得不接受且内化。创造扭曲的从来不只是他们自己 而是整个“愚民”集体所塑造的 病态的社会价值观。因此 主角们最终所战斗的 正是这样被他者叙事所压制的 放弃思考自我奴役的大众心态。

但在那个圣诞夜之后 权力不复存在 民众们未能掌握回叙事的夹缝之时 每个人心底独属于自己的扭曲又悄然滋生。当压迫与暴力退居高阁 每一个人获得的 都是由自洽的经验 记忆与感受所织就的 高度贴合其内心创伤与欲望的最优解映射之时 当“错误”的理由本身就被剥夺之时 当浇灭反抗之火的冷水来源于自己内心之时 还有几人能守住自己的反抗之心？

记忆宫殿在正篇中始终以扭曲 阴暗的一面示众 仿佛它天生就是一个与“现实”对立的异物 是逃避 堕落与非理性的象征。然而 这种直觉本身或许正是一种误导。现实的存在固然不可辩驳 但“什么是现实”却从来不是一个已经被固定下来的答案。我们所经验到的现实 更像是思维为了应对某个被假定为客观存在的外部世界而不断生成的内在映射：它之所以显得稳定而可靠 并非因为它绝对真实 而是因为它足够自洽 能够支撑理解 行动与生活的展开。

在这个意义上 记忆宫殿并非凭空生长于现实之外的“虚假之物”。它与所谓的现实一样 都是由经验 记忆与情感所建构的结果 只是它更赤裸地暴露了这种建构性本身。幻象并不天然等同于欺骗 它同样可以是诚实的——在自身的框架内自洽 并清楚地承认其来源与边界；真正危险的并非“虚构”的存在 而是当某种建构被伪装为唯一的真理 当它遮蔽了自身作为映射的属性 并被用来冻结可能性 强化定义 免除修正之时。也正因如此 记忆宫殿之所以令人不安 并不是因为它“不真实” 而是因为它让人第一次直面一个事实：所谓坚实不移的现实 本就建立在同样脆弱 可变且需要被不断校正的心理结构之上。

是的 在怪盗掌持正义的世界里 一切反派都被命运写定了作为主角们绊脚石的结局 只等主角们披荆斩棘 证明自己的必然性 “挺身而出 跨越难关 获得成长就能走下去” 但现实何尝有这么简单？面对不可避免的失败与痛苦 沉溺于无处可供抓手的绝望 是长大之后的少年少女多半可能的人生。丸喜提供了这样一个可能：交出你修正自我锚点的权利 换取一个永远不需修正的终极定义。当你全身心的信以为真 并且不再质疑有其他可能时 这样的“虚构”就不再能以真假而区分；既然一切都没有了“虚假”的阻隔 那么还有什么能阻止你选择一个不再有痛苦的未来？

是的 面对痛苦 有时逃避并没有错 但“无论现实多么让人痛苦 要是连改变它都放弃的话 一切都完了”。当所有人都把实现欲望的希冀从行动转向自我的曲解与催眠之时 认知之外的 真正构建人与人之间关系的“世界”也将不复存在。

“真理”是有限的 因此人类需要“呼吸着以戏言稀释的少量真实 人才能维持健全的心”；但“自由意志”更是有限的 当意志自愿的被谎言淹没 “自由”又何谈存在？也许丸喜可以用覆盖全人类认知的方式 将所有人最本征的愿望铸造成坚不可摧的现实 让谎言这个概念本身不复存在；但当痛苦被提前消解 失败被结构性规避 个体不再需要在不完备性中建构生存的意义；拒绝让任何一个终极定义 替代持续的 自我修正的映射过程 在不可避免的失败 误判与创伤中 仍然保留重新绘制映射的权利 人类才能证明自己不灭的人格（Persona）。认识到现实的边界 是逃离“现实”的幻梦的第一步 但如果永远都无法与现实的边界所和解 永远都徘徊在自认为的现实之外 唾弃真实 拥抱虚幻 那么“现实”的幻梦依然若即若离 永远难逃其梦魇。

丸喜所建构的现实抛给所有人一个问题：
如果剥夺你改变现实的权利换取一个永恒的伊甸园 你是否愿意永远生活在其中？

怪盗团所作出的回答是：
吃下智慧果 带着所有人回到大地之上 夺回着那个允许人类继续犯错 修正 再建构的世界。

所以 怪盗团所贯彻的美学不仅仅是简单的对与错 正义与邪恶。诡骗师们所坚持的唯一权利 就是绝不将构建自我现实的权利假托给他人 绝不放弃重新构建自我现实的权利；在承认现实的不可知性与定义的脆弱之后 依然选择行动与承担。

如果说夜之城带给我的是一种无论何时都能简单的回望 自由的探索和回忆的故乡感；异世界中的东京就像是从人生的高速列车上短暂下车 在迷茫中寻找下一程旅途的换乘站。现实中的东京是一座庞大的城市 但在 P5 的世界中 一切现代都市的体验都被精巧的折叠在了一处又一处狭小 却被人情温暖挤得满满当当的街道与店铺中。这段 detour 似乎长的望不见边际 塞满了惊险刺激的一波三折 可当你见缝插针的去读书 锻炼 泡咖啡 侍弄花草 在大街小巷吃汉堡 打街机 看电影 泡温泉之时以及把一段段偶然进入自己人生的邂逅 在契机之下 由共同的审美或追求 变成超越“泛泛之交”的关系之时 它又显得如此短暂 只等你从那个还会在涩谷站的立交结构迷路的青涩少年刚刚毕业时 列车的报站铃声就就催促你登上下一程。

我并不是一个见识广博的人 从小到大所见过的 与故乡不同的风景屈指可数。我也经常幻想着前往远方 以求冲散一切呆板 无趣的现实的万灵药 但当真正踏上离家一万公里 横跨半个地球的旅途 当真正走在一个又一个陌生城市的街头 虽然感官中总能识别出来源与距离与时间的异域质地 但目之所及的依然是无数人所共同经历的 与我的人生似乎千篇一律的生活。我又不得不承认事实的冷酷：人类所制造的交通工具并不是通往异世界的一扇门 横跨七大洲四大洋 无论在世界上的何处 我出生前二十年的全球化 现代化的余波都已经让这屿蓝色星球上几乎任何地方的人都度过着极其相仿的生活。我丝毫不怀疑 即使我有一天能够亲身从涉谷站走出 站在 Shibuya Crossing 的站前广场 我也无法感受到游戏中 JOKER 第一天上学时迷路走出那样 迷茫中莫名的亲切感。

review:
[h1]P5r，一则灰色现实下的童话歌剧[/h1]
稚嫩的高中生们戴上假面，游走于社会暗面，将一封封预告信化作子弹射出，向“大人们”举起反旗——你一眼就知道它又是一出结构俗套的剧目。
可看着他们纵身跃上舞台，跨过一个接一个宫殿，肩并肩走到舞台中央直面终局……当决战的音乐响起，你还是会情不自禁，你还是会相信这是一个动人的故事，结局的演出不够盛大，可让这段旅程真正拥有重量的不是最后的“高燃演出”，而是一路走来见证的所有。

[h1]【！！！以下内容涉及强剧透与少许不满！！！】[/h1]
[h3]“大侦探”明智与“女路人”芳泽[/h3]
这两位人物是我短短怪盗生涯的最大意难平，明智没有支付[b]“代价”[/b]，芳泽“霞”没有展现[b]弧光[/b]。
首先是周可儿的“宿敌”，大侦探明智。坦白说这个角色登场到中期我才意识到这是个与周可儿对称的宿敌型角色，二人的关系是时刻紧绷着的一根线，在平静下双方暗暗的角力，保持着一个微妙的平衡关系。但这根平衡线剪的太过粗暴了，明智的背叛是我有所预料的，但明智的反差爆发是令我难蚌的，我不是在批评真实的明智人设如何（相反我更喜欢他放开后的性格），而是在说故事上明智的背叛几乎完全颠覆了他之前的理念与作为。
初登场的明智所秉持的程序正义是与怪盗团的道德正义一次极好的理念碰撞，明智也确确实实直白的在这个时期对周可儿下了决斗通牒，直白的说出了自己视周可儿为劲敌的念头，然后呢？然后他就成为了那个歇斯底里的明智。
拙劣的阴谋被怪盗团早早识破，背地里的言论与在宫殿最后一战的宣言更是宣告了所有的理念和坚持都化作飞灰，一切的一切都是为了最后自己焚尽所有的复仇大戏。他的复仇计划在师童眼中毫无威胁，自己更是在最后一战被三言两语动摇选择救下怪盗团，他作为反派本应有的闪光都被模糊放弃掉了，成为了一个为黑而黑的，为对称而对称的【宿敌】。
最后最后是我最不能接受的，就是无人审判他，明智不应有一个模糊的悬念结局，他需要一个结局，一段判词，一则明确的【裁决】。虽然P5r整体叙事上升到了对整个社会的反抗，但它的底色确实仍保留了童话的一面，不愿伤人，执着的拯救世人的怪盗团为什么会放任一个手上占满鲜血的人在世间自由行走，春的父亲怎么办，双叶的母亲又会怎么想，为什么她们二人能自如的在最后原谅这个【罪犯】？
在师童宫殿时明智最后的舍身只称得上是偿还，我对此毫无感激，而当我看到第三学期的明智是周可儿的愿望时更是让我产生了游玩P5r以来最大的不适感，如果一定要复活他，那是要为了让他为其恶行赎罪，而不是为了什么堂堂正正的决斗。

而霞，我亲爱的红发女路人。其实她的个人剧情量确实不算少，但是整体的塑造却极其的【慵懒】，是编剧执笔上的慵懒。
霞在一、二学期的剧情只是纯粹的隔靴搔痒，既没有对主线产生大幅度的影响，也没有与怪盗团产生过深的联系，几乎只是一个在周可儿身边打转的可爱学妹。一二学期的P5r只是一个劲的在霞身上埋伏笔，开场对怪盗团理念的反对，中期面具的觉醒和始终无法忘怀的伤痛都预示着这个角色埋藏着更多的故事，可一二学期中的霞真的是有万般理由远离所有怪盗团活动，她的出场与其说是塑造人物，不如说是在吊人胃口。
当真正等到第三学期，真正需要为这个人物动笔时，编剧却又将之前赋予霞的一个个特质扁平化，然后无视掉，使其回归成一个平庸可爱的花瓶角色。她被救回怪盗团时的再觉醒极其迅速生硬。哪怕她在丸喜的乐园再多沉溺挣扎几日，与怪盗团多进行几次碰撞，霞这一人物都有再升华塑造的可能，但霞几乎是被周可儿一巴掌打飞然后立刻踏上了讨伐丸喜的道路。个人COOP中也只是在延续前两个学期的“可爱学妹”标签，对于姐姐的痛苦与思考本可以在COOP中进一步挖掘却也是重拿轻放，将更多的笔墨放在了与周可儿二人转上，姐姐就像霞坏掉的手机一样，只是一个理由、一个钩子罢了。结局动画女路人的淡漠行为更是给了这名角色的塑造重重一击，即便我早已听说这一结局，真正看到时也是哑口无言。

[h3]凑凑忙忙的第三学期[/h3]
用笼统的话来概括，P5r整体的主线是经典王道故事的一种再演。可以说它套路重复、故事俗套，但总有人喜欢（起码我很喜欢），可令人遗憾的是，这个故事绝对称不上圆满落幕。
作为承接无印剧情的第三学期，新增的怪盗团coop剧情套路化严重，本身在无印结局前已经使用过的套路化手法一扭头又见到一次，没有太多铺垫与修改，周可儿只是看着团员排排队找你进化，然后再无波澜。第三学期我几乎只是补完最后几人的满COOP然后就只能天天丢飞镖打台球，丸喜的执着和理念被过度内化在周可儿与丸喜的个人剧情中，丸喜对除了周可儿以外的团员影响也过早的被清除。
还是如对霞的思考一样，如果团员们或多或少在丸喜的乐园多沉沦几日，或许就能有更多的笔墨去同时拓展丸喜和团员们的塑造，而不是简单的喊几句热血口号就再度高举反抗的旗帜。

初登场的明智所秉持的程序正义是与怪盗团的道德正义一次极好的理念碰撞，明智也确确实实直白的在这个时期对周可儿下了决斗通牒，直白的说出了自己视周可儿为劲敌的念头，然后呢？然后他就成为了那个歇斯底里的明智。 拙劣的阴谋被怪盗团早早识破，背地里的言论与在宫殿最后一战的宣言更是宣告了所有的理念和坚持都化作飞灰，一切的一切都是为了最后自己焚尽所有的复仇大戏。他的复仇计划在师童眼中毫无威胁，自己更是在最后一战被三言两语动摇选择救下怪盗团，他作为反派本应有的闪光都被模糊放弃掉了，成为了一个为黑而黑的，为对称而对称的【宿敌】。 最后最后是我最不能接受的，就是无人审判他，明智不应有一个模糊的悬念结局，他需要一个结局，一段判词，一则明确的【裁决】。虽然P5r整体叙事上升到了对整个社会的反抗，但它的底色确实仍保留了童话的一面，不愿伤人，执着的拯救世人的怪盗团为什么会放任一个手上占满鲜血的人在世间自由行走，春的父亲怎么办，双叶的母亲又会怎么想，为什么她们二人能自如的在最后原谅这个【罪犯】？ 霞在一、二学期的剧情只是纯粹的隔靴搔痒，既没有对主线产生大幅度的影响，也没有与怪盗团产生过深的联系，几乎只是一个在周可儿身边打转的可爱学妹。一二学期的P5r只是一个劲的在霞身上埋伏笔，开场对怪盗团理念的反对，中期面具的觉醒和始终无法忘怀的伤痛都预示着这个角色埋藏着更多的故事，可一二学期中的霞真的是有万般理由远离所有怪盗团活动，她的出场与其说是塑造人物，不如说是在吊人胃口。 当真正等到第三学期，真正需要为这个人物动笔时，编剧却又将之前赋予霞的一个个特质扁平化，然后无视掉，使其回归成一个平庸可爱的花瓶角色。她被救回怪盗团时的再觉醒极其迅速生硬。哪怕她在丸喜的乐园再多沉溺挣扎几日，与怪盗团多进行几次碰撞，霞这一人物都有再升华塑造的可能，但霞几乎是被周可儿一巴掌打飞然后立刻踏上了讨伐丸喜的道路。个人COOP中也只是在延续前两个学期的“可爱学妹”标签，对于姐姐的痛苦与思考本可以在COOP中进一步挖掘却也是重拿轻放，将更多的笔墨放在了与周可儿二人转上，姐姐就像霞坏掉的手机一样，只是一个理由、一个钩子罢了。结局动画女路人的淡漠行为更是给了这名角色的塑造重重一击，即便我早已听说这一结局，真正看到时也是哑口无言。 看着这如画般的一群人嬉笑打闹，怀揣着不舍的心情，和怪盗团说了再见。

第一次听说p5，是上高中的时候。看见粉丝逢人便说"P5天下第一！"，对此我不屑一故（笑），觉得不过是狂热粉丝的吹捧，小众圈子的优越感共鸣（诚然那时候女神异闻录系列已经因为P5全球出圈）。高中的学习生活已经近乎占据了我一切时间，整个三年都被压得喘不过气。人们都说作为学生只需要做好自己的本职工作就好了（笑），根本无需过多操心家人的情况、别人行为的好坏、朋友的关系，似乎连我本人是否过的开心、自由也成了身外之物。

彼时高中生的我无法想象一群生活在东京的同龄人竟然还能经历如此天马行空的生活，更无法共鸣雨宫莲一行人即使承受整个社会、整个国家的偏见也要去贯彻始终的正义，觉得这不过只是一群热血青年与大反派智斗的老套故事罢了，我不关心这个，更不需要这个。经历了高考、大学毕业，终于以为自己能有所成长，内心变得强大，喜怒不形于色，再也不因他人的事情影响自身。然而成人的世界才是充满压力与绝望，不抱有期待，就不会再受伤，我想以此来欺骗自己。和那些被社会压迫到只剩自保的人没什么两样：他们用扭曲自保，我用麻木自保。终于，不得不去承认，那被我随意地抛在一边恣意贬低的高中生活，似乎也不是那么暗淡无光了。

真正玩这个游戏已经是研究生阶段了。整个游玩的过程中，我的内心就像洋葱被一层一层拨开，那些往日被我唾弃的无聊的反抗精神，似乎不再是口头上的一句空话，而是会催人前进的力量。这时我才意识到P5的魅力：一个个看似简单的故事，不是无谓的白日做梦和逃避现实，而是我们每一个成年人平淡生活里的英雄梦想。它没有许诺一个乌托邦，怪盗团到最后也没能把社会改成理想模样，他们只是让一些人重新开始自己做选择—而这一点，恰恰是成年人最需要、也最容易放弃的东西。我早已不再期许去简单爽快地打倒生活中的大反派，而是共鸣于做出“可以不再欺骗自己”这一选择的艰难。

当我意识到这一点的时候，虽说称不上无聊的大人，但我大概已经不再是那个可以完全可以不处处听从老师、家人的想法，不被他人的眼光限制的曾经的自己。不过意识到这一点已经弥足珍贵，我不需要回到高中补一场叛逆，我更庆幸在现在的生活里，我对某件事仍然愿意期待，对某个人仍然愿意受影响，对某个不公仍然愿意不舒服。
